title: Senior U.S. HR Operations Executive | U.S. Staffing
description:
**Hiring: Senior U.S. HR Operations Executive | U.S. Staffing**

**Company:**
ClickSoft Solutions

**Location:**
Hyderabad, Telangana, India

**Experience:**
3–6 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Work Mode:**
Work from Office

**Shift:**
U.S. Night Shift

**About the Role :**

ClickSoft Solutions is looking for an experienced
**Senior U.S. HR Operations Executive**
with hands-on experience in U.S. HR operations, employee onboarding, C2C contracts, documentation, and immigration processes.

The ideal candidate should be capable of independently managing employee documentation, onboarding activities, compliance records, and U.S. immigration-related processes.

Key Responsibilities

**U.S. HR Operations & Onboarding**

* Manage end-to-end
  **W-2 employee onboarding and offboarding**
  .
* Collect, verify, and maintain employee documents and employment records.
* Handle W-2 onboarding documentation and coordinate with employees.
* Manage employee records, HR databases, trackers, and agreements.
* Handle employee queries and follow up on pending documentation.

**C2C Contracts & Documentation**

* Prepare and manage
  **C2C contracts and paperwork**
  .
* Coordinate with vendors regarding contracts, consultant documents, and compliance requirements.
* Maintain accurate vendor and consultant records.
* Handle W-2, C2C, and 1099 documentation as applicable.

**U.S. Immigration**

* Coordinate U.S. immigration documentation and filing activities.
* Support
  **H-1B petition filing**
  and documentation.
* Handle or coordinate
  **PWD (Prevailing Wage Determination) filing**
  .
* Support
  **PERM filing**
  and related documentation.
* Support
  **I-140 filing**
  and maintain required records.
* Coordinate with immigration attorneys, employees, and internal teams.
* Track pending documents and provide timely updates.

**Compliance & Payroll Coordination**

* Handle
  **I-9 and E-Verify**
  processes and maintain related records.
* Coordinate payroll documentation and timesheet-related activities.
* Support employee verification and background verification.
* Maintain employment agreements and compliance documents.
* Assist with audits and ensure the confidentiality of employee information.

**Reporting & Team Support**

* Prepare HR trackers and MIS reports using Microsoft Excel.
* Maintain accurate employee and immigration records.
* Guide junior team members and support process-related queries.
* Ensure HR activities are completed accurately and within deadlines.

**Required Skills :**

* 3–6 years of experience in
  **U.S. HR Operations / U.S. Staffing HR**
  .
* Hands-on experience with
  **W-2 onboarding and C2C contracts**
  .
* Knowledge of W-2, C2C, and 1099 documentation.
* Practical experience with
  **I-9 and E-Verify**
  .
* Experience supporting
  **H-1B, PWD, PERM, and I-140**
  filing processes.
* Knowledge of U.S. employee documentation and HR compliance.
* Experience with payroll coordination and timesheet management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong English communication, documentation, and follow-up skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities independently.
* Willingness to work in the U.S. night shift.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in HR is preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

* Previous experience in a U.S. IT staffing or consulting company.
* Experience handling U.S. employees, consultants, and vendor documentation.
* Experience with HRIS, payroll systems, and compliance documentation.

Apply Now

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:

aravind@clicksoftit.com

title: Oracle HCM (Absence, Benefits, Compensation, Core HR, Help Desk, OTL ORC, Payroll & Talent) - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Oracle HCM / Oracle Payroll with Fast Formulas – Senior**
**Role Title:**
Senior Consultant – Oracle HCM / Oracle Payroll (Fast Formulas)
  
  
**Experience Level:**
5–8 years
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Senior Consultant will play a key role in the design, development, and support of Oracle HCM Cloud with a primary focus on
**Oracle Payroll**
and
**Fast Formulas**
. This position requires strong functional and technical expertise to implement payroll solutions, build advanced formulas, troubleshoot payroll results, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality Oracle HCM Cloud projects.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Oracle Payroll & Fast Formulas**

* Design, develop, and maintain Payroll Fast Formulas (Earnings, Deductions, Absence, Proration, Elements Eligibility Rules, and Validation).
* Configure and support Oracle HCM Payroll modules including Elements, Balances, Payroll Flows, Costing, and QuickPay.
* Analyse payroll results, logics, and costing outputs to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Create and optimize Fast Formulas to meet complex client payroll requirements.

**Implementation & Solution Design**

* Participate in end-to-end Oracle HCM Cloud implementations and enhancements.
* Capture client requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle Payroll solutions.
* Support data conversion activities including element entry uploads, costing data, and payroll mapping.

**Integration & Reporting**

* Work with integration teams on HCM Extracts, HDL loads, OIC integrations related to Payroll.
* Build and enhance OTBI and BI Publisher reports for payroll reporting needs.

**Support & Testing**

* Provide L2/L3 support for payroll issues.
* Lead UAT, regression, and parallel payroll testing cycles.
* Document configurations, solution design, and operational procedures.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Mentor junior consultants on Payroll and Fast Formulas.
* Coordinate with Functional Leads, Technical Teams, and Client HR/Payroll teams.
* Contribute to best practices, reusable components, and project documentation.

**Technical Skills**
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll configuration.
* Strong expertise in Fast Formulas (Payroll, Absence, Benefits, HCM Extract, and Elements).
* Knowledge of HDL, HCM Extracts, Payroll Flows, and Calculation Cards.
* Strong understanding of payroll legislative rules and statutory compliance.
* Experience with BIP, OTBI, and SQL for troubleshooting.

**Functional Skills**

* Solid understanding of Core HR, Absence Management, Time & Labor is a plus.
* Ability to analyse payroll issues and propose effective solutions.
* Knowledge of payroll processes: payroll run, costing, retro pay, tax calculations, etc.

**Professional Attributes**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and client-facing abilities.
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities.
* Experience in Agile or Waterfall delivery frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll Certification.
* Prior consulting experience with global payroll implementations.

**About The Role / Why Join**

* Opportunity to work on transformative Oracle Cloud projects.
* Exposure to cross-module HCM Cloud functionalities.
* Collaborative environment with growth and leadership opportunities.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Analyst – Human Capital Generalist
description:
**About DESRI**
DESRI (formerly D. E. Shaw Renewable Investments) is a market-leading owner and operator of renewable energy projects throughout the United States. We have acquired or developed approximately 13 gigawatts of contracted capacity across a portfolio of over 85 renewable energy projects in 24 states.
  
  
**About The Role**
DESRI is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented individual to join our Human Capital team in Hyderabad as a Human Capital Generalist. This role will serve as a key operational partner to the Core Human Capital function. The role is responsible for managing critical HC operations in areas such as onboarding, separations, benefits administration, statutory activities, etc. The role further undertakes talent engagement and talent development activities including other initiatives that help employees grow professionally and maintain a work-life balance.
  
  
This position is ideal for an early-career professional interested in building a strong foundation in Human Capital Operations within a fast-paced, high-performing environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* In this role, you will be responsible for handling various key employee lifecycle processes such as onboarding, transitions, separations, benefits administration and learning and development with a focus on delivering positive, consistent employee experience at every stage.
* The core activities will also include managing accurate documentation, data entry, and validation, as well as contributing to HR process improvement, leveraging automation, and supporting audit and compliance readiness.
* You will also work with vendors to ensure timely execution of deliverables, while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
* The role also requires you to drive and conduct employee engagement events to enhance employee experience.
* Furthermore, you will serve as a first point of contact for employee queries, demonstrating sound judgement and empathy, and escalating complex matters to the appropriate HRBP.
* You will partner with HR Business Partners and business leaders to support BU-specific talent priorities, including people pulse analysis and BU-wise initiatives.

****Qualification****
**The Ideal Candidate Should Hold Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2-4 years of work experience in HR with exposure to both HR Operations and HRBP or generalist work.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and comfort working across HR systems, ticketing platforms and reporting tools.
* Ability to manage operational processes while balancing responsiveness, accuracy, and employee experience
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership, follow-through when managing competing priorities
* Analytical thinking and comfort with data - able to identify patterns in attrition, engagement, or headcount data and surface meaningful insights.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships across levels and deliver messages clearly in both writing and conversation
* Professional presence, sound judgment, and ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion
* Appetite to grow - this role is designed to expand in scope, and we are looking for someone with the ambition and capability to grow alongside it.

title: Senior, Tax Services-EMEA-Middle East Payroll-Hyderabad
description:

**Position Summary**

We are looking to hire an experienced Senior – Middle East Payroll, Reporting & Analytics professional who brings a strong combination of payroll domain knowledge and technical reporting capability. * Experience in domestic payroll operations for Middle East countries.
* Exposure to payroll systems, HR systems, or finance/reporting platforms.
* Knowledge of process improvement, controls, and standardization.
* Experience supporting SLA-driven operations.

* Middle East Payroll
* Domestic Payroll Operations
* Payroll Reconciliation
* Payroll Reporting
* Power BI
* MIS Reporting
* Dashboarding
* Advanced Excel

**Job Description**
**Engagement Manager (US Region)- HYD based**

We are the preferred choice of 1000+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.

The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
  
  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment

**What This Role Is**
Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision-making.
  
  
**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**
This role sits at the intersection of:
  
  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:
* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go-live milestones

**What The Work Looks Like**

* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.

Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end-to-end.
  
  
That means:
  
  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.

**Who Thrives Here**

* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.

**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**

* Coordination-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context

**What We’re Looking For**

* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product-oriented thinking
* Data-driven and automation-first approach to problem solving

**What We Offer:**

* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

This role will serve as a strategic partner to HR, Talent, Compensation, Payroll, and IT teams, ensuring Workday and related HR systems deliver scalable, efficient, and user-friendly solutions that enhance employee experience and business outcomes. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Workday Core HCM, Talent & Performance, Advanced Compensation, HR business processes, reporting, workflow automation, system configuration, and production support. title: Workflow Analyst I, CXQO
description:
**Description**
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
  
  
Amazon Physical Stores is more start-up than big-company a group of entrepreneurial perceptive and creative leaders with innovation at our core. We're pushing the state of the art in helping customers shop in engaging fast and safe ways. To date we've created stores that let you use an app to enter take what you want and exit the store. Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you're done shopping you can just leave the store. Shortly after we'll charge your Amazon account and send you a receipt. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including computer vision sensor fusion and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an innovative program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision machine learning distributed systems and hardware design.
  
  
We are looking for a Workforce Capacity Planning (CP) Analyst who is passionate about customer experience, thinks and acts globally, is a strong communicator and networker to build successful working relationships across CXQO network and has the edge to drive industry standard innovations. The ideal candidate will need to possess a strong schedule optimization background that enables them to manage quantitative planning to achieve productivity goals for the network, possess an analytical background that enables them to manage network planning experience a wide range of problem solving situations which are strategic to real-time to identify opportunities for improvement and is able to extensively use data collection for further analysis. The Workforce CP Analyst is responsible to share guidance on real-time staffing adjustments work with sites on special events planning build processes to manage contingency real-time business domain blending to help business meet their service levels; they aid as a resource advisor and are a close working partner with Operations and other functional support teams. The successful candidate will also need to be an analytical problem solver who is comfortable in a fast-paced, multi-tasking, high-energy environment. This role requires candidates to be flexible to working in Night shifts and rotational week-offs. Please note: this team is not customer-facing.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Generate forecast plan capacity for multiple network sites successfully manage short term staffing of the sites (4 to 6 weeks) work closely with long-term planning program Ops and multiple stakeholders and come up with right input and exception mechanisms on factors affecting forecast
* Create and accurately maintain CXQO associate shift schedules ensuring that shifts are optimally planned to meet the short term forecast requirements and SLs (Service Levels)
* Build short/long term operational plans for network sites to optimize variable costs associated with staffing
* Creates intra-day daily weekly plan for business to meet the forecasted numbers and required productivity
* Setup feedback mechanism to share overall capacity planning processes improvements and drive better planning accuracy for future
* Performs dive deep on daily weekly and monthly site/network performance to provide feedback to Operations and other program management stakeholders to help sites meet their efficiency goals
* Monitor actual staffing levels against plan and take corrective actions to flex-up or flex down as required like OT (Over Time) calls cross skill support shrinkage shift changes to improve service levels
* Effectively plan and monitor associate adherence to the assigned schedules & plan non-productive activities
* Maintain CXQO associate matrix for each site based on its hours of operation seating and transportation plan
* Participate in initiatives to cater to growing business needs
* Connect and network with stake-holders including but not limited to operations program management training GREF teams
* Supports Capacity Planning leadership by maintaining accurate records of planned and required headcount in each of business groups/marketplace on a weekly basis
* Communicate and maintain vision, Leadership Principles, and culture with the team
* Written and verbal communication up to operations level

**About The Team**
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.
* Experience demonstrating problem solving and root cause analysis
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience with SQL or ETL
* Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross-functional teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with strong project management skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
* Experience running an effective operational excellence program
* 5+ years of engineering team management in a fast-paced operations environment experience
* Experience in inter-team working skills to develop partnership with partner, tech team and operating at leadership levels

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Training Associate is part of a global function called Operations and Processes – Training and Communications. This is a global role that supports training delivery to over 2000 Research & Development (R&D) employees across Haleon’s R&D organisation.

Training assignments include, but are not limited to written standards, ways of working, system training, product information where applicable and capability training.

* Ensure all current R&D procedures are maintained in their current version and assigned to ensure that R&D colleagues are trained in line with industry requirements.
* Partner with the Process, Standards & Documentation team to support the development and delivery of learning that enable business readiness and effective adoption.
* Subject matter expert for training processing and applications, providing support to colleagues as needed.
* Develop and report training metrics to drive training compliance and monitoring to ensure audit/inspection readiness.
* Provide audit and regulatory inspection support across R&D by providing timely documentation and supporting the implementation of effective corrective and preventative actions (CAPA) to meet required timelines.

**Essential**

description:

 At
 **Marcus Evans** 
 , our people are the cornerstone of our success, and the Global Learning \& Quality(L\&Q) department is integral to nurturing that cornerstone. Currently, the L\&Q team is essential in shaping our workforce through comprehensive new hire training and ongoing professional development.  **Hyderabad** 
 office.

* Ability to understand business processes, gather requirements, identify improvement opportunities, and support the implementation of effective solutions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact professionally with candidates, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams.
* Experience facilitating or delivering training sessions, providing guidance to participants, and communicating processes and information effectively.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and delivering accurate results within deadlines.

* Learning Analytics \& Reporting

* Learner satisfaction scores

* Operational excellence and governance compliance

title: Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation
description:
**About the Team**
 At DoorDash, people are our most important asset. The People Technology Team helps to deliver and facilitate strategic technology projects within the People Team. This role will be focused on supporting our People Technology function as we continue to optimize the advancement of our organization. We're looking for Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation to help us scale Wolt \+ DoorDash's enormous growth. Come help shape a best in class People Technology team!
   

  

**About the Role**
 Based in India, we are looking for a Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation with demonstrated HRIS ownership to assist with strategic initiatives across our organization. Experience with Workday is preferable for this role. You will work cross\-functionally to achieve business goals through system configuration, testing and documentation. As a Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation you will help deliver solutions to support business strategy, and assist in the implementation, maintenance and enhancement of people technology systems.
   

  

**You're excited about this opportunity because...**
* Configure and maintain Workday Compensation module elements, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, matrices, eligibility rules, and compensation review/merit cycles
* Partner with Total Rewards to translate compensation strategy (base pay, bonus, equity, allowances) into scalable Workday configuration
* Lead annual and off\-cycle compensation events (merit, bonus, and stock cycles) end\-to\-end, including planning, testing, mass data loads via Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), and validation
* Build and maintain compensation grades, guidelines, and eligibility rules to support pay equity and market\-competitive pay decisions
* Partner with Payroll and Finance to ensure accurate downstream processing of compensation changes
* Provide global production analysis and support (break/fix analysis, reporting, business process administration, etc.) for Compensation
* Troubleshoot and resolve compensation\-related issues, working cross\-functionally with HRBPs and Payroll
* Manage Workday releases (bi\-annual updates) by reviewing new compensation features, assessing impact, and coordinating regression testing
* Rigorously document compensation configuration and business processes to build operational excellence
* Ensure data integrity across compensation data, working closely with cross\-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities
* Train end\-users and peers on compensation processes and self\-service functionality as needed
* Maintain the security groups and access policies tied to compensation data as a light, supporting part of the role


**We're excited about you because...**
* You have 5\+ years of work experience in Workday Compensation maintenance/configuration
* Proven experience leading full compensation review cycles (merit, bonus, stock) within Workday
* You are passionate about system optimization and employee experience
* You are a strong business thinker, able to use 'first principles' to solve challenging business problems at their root level
* You are data\-driven, able to analyze data with strong attention to detail and accuracy, and passionate about telling the story behind the data hence turning the data into configuration
* You are a self\-motivated, rapid learner, excited about further developing your analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Basic working knowledge of Workday security concepts (security groups, domain policies) as they relate to compensation data access
* You are results\-oriented, always evaluating whether our team's activities are achieving the desired, measurable impact
* You are an owner, always looking for opportunities to learn and better your work product
* You are comfortable and thrive in a fast\-paced, continually changing team\-oriented environment and able to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously
* You have a BA/BS degree in quantitative or business fields, or equivalent work experience
* You have an analytical mindset and a "People First" mentality with demonstrated ability to work through complex, ambiguous problems using data and creating configuration solutions based on that data
* You have strong written/verbal communication
* Workday certified in Compensation preferred


**Next steps**
 If you are excited about working in a high\-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!
   

  

 We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!
   

  

 Please note that we do not accept applications coming in via email. Please submit your application in English via our job portal.
   

  

**About DoorDash**

title: Training Specialist II, Account Health Support
description:
**Description**
 Do you want to define and drive the learning strategy for an organization that impacts thousands of associates globally?
   

  

 As a Site Trainer, you will own the end\-to\-end training lifecycle — from identifying strategic learning needs to designing scalable programs, mentoring trainers, and measuring business\-level impact. You will bring deep expertise in communication training and instructional design to shape how teams develop, perform, and grow. This role goes beyond delivery — you will set the direction, influence stakeholders, and build training frameworks that scale across sites and geographies.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Training Strategy \& Program Ownership
   

  

* Own and drive the training strategy for assigned programs or business lines, defining learning roadmaps aligned with organizational goals and operational priorities
* Design and implement scalable training frameworks that can be replicated across sites, teams, and geographies
* Identify emerging skill gaps through proactive analysis of business trends, performance data, and stakeholder input; develop strategic interventions without waiting for escalation
* Lead the design and rollout of organization\-wide communication excellence programs (business writing, verbal fluency, presentation skills, stakeholder communication)


 Advanced Training Delivery \& Communication Coaching
   

  

* Facilitate high\-complexity training sessions including leadership communication workshops, advanced soft skills programs, and cross\-functional capability\-building initiatives
* Serve as the subject matter expert for communication training — design and deliver modules on accent modification, business communication, customer interaction strategies, and executive communication
* Lead Train\-the\-Trainer (TTT) programs to build trainer capability across sites; certify and calibrate trainers on delivery standards
* Design and facilitate simulations, role\-plays, and scenario\-based learning for complex, ambiguous situations


 Curriculum Design \& Innovation
   

  

* Architect comprehensive curricula using advanced instructional design methodologies (ADDIE, SAM, Agile Learning Design) with emphasis on scalability and learner experience
* Pioneer innovative learning formats (microlearning, gamification, AI\-assisted content, peer learning communities) to drive engagement and retention
* Establish content governance standards — version control, review cadence, and retirement criteria for training materials
* Design multi\-level assessment frameworks including competency\-based evaluations, capstone projects, and certification pathways


 Data\-Driven Training Effectiveness \& Impact
   

  

* Define and own training effectiveness metrics across the full Kirkpatrick model (Levels 1\-4\); establish causal links between training programs and business outcomes
* Build and maintain executive\-level dashboards that communicate training ROI, learner progression, and capability development trends
* Conduct deep\-dive analyses on underperforming programs; develop and execute improvement action plans with measurable targets
* Benchmark training programs against industry standards and internal best practices; drive continuous improvement through data


 Stakeholder Influence \& Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Partner with senior leaders across Operations, Quality, WFM, and HR to align training investments with business strategy
* Represent training in business reviews (WBRs, MBRs, QBRs) — present insights, advocate for learning initiatives, and influence resource allocation decisions
* Mentor and develop Training Specialists; provide structured coaching, feedback, and career development guidance
* Drive cross\-site standardization of training practices while adapting for local context and needs


 A day in the life
   

  

 Your morning may begin with a strategy session with operations leadership, aligning training priorities with upcoming business goals and identifying capability gaps across multiple programs. You then review training effectiveness data across sites, spotting trends and crafting recommendations for program redesign. Mid\-day, you mentor a team of trainers on advanced facilitation techniques and provide feedback on their curriculum designs. In the afternoon, you lead a cross\-functional working group to launch a new communication excellence program, defining the rollout plan, success metrics, and stakeholder communication strategy. You close the day by presenting quarterly training impact analysis to senior leadership, demonstrating how your programs drove measurable improvements in quality scores and operational KPIs.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Training team is dedicated to accelerating specialist readiness and continuous development at scale. We partner closely with Operations, Quality, and Workforce Management across multiple sites and geographies to deliver learning solutions that drive performance outcomes. Our vision is to build a culture of continuous learning where every specialist has the skills and confidence to deliver world\-class service. As a Site Trainer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping team strategy, mentoring junior trainers, and raising the bar for learning programs across the organization.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2\+ years of learning design, learning science, instructional design, educational psychology, or similar field experience
* Experience with Learning \& Development and course facilitation or an equivalent professional qualification, or experience in a training role, including technical training, or a mix of training, performance management and coaching/mentoring
* Experience designing and delivering training programs at scale across multiple teams or sites
* Experience mentoring or leading other trainers (formally or informally)
* Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) strategy, governance, and reporting


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Master's degree in Organizational Development, Communication, Instructional Design, or a related field
* Experience as a Communication or Soft Skills Trainer with program\-level ownership in a contact center, BPO, or customer service environment
* Professional certification in Learning \& Development (e.g., CPTM, ATD\-CPTD, CIPD, or equivalent)
* Experience with e\-learning authoring tools (Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, or similar) at an advanced level
* Experience in designing and delivering accent modification or language proficiency coaching programs
* Process improvement certification (Six Sigma Green Belt, Lean, or Kaizen)

By giving customers more of what they want \- low prices, vast selection, and convenience \- Amazon continues to grow and evolve as a world\-class e\-commerce platform. We treat every day like day one: a day to bring in fresh ideas, a day to challenge convention, a day to make more good things happen for our customers. title: Director – People & Talent
description:
**Director – People \& Talent** 




  





 Location: Hyderabad
 



 Experience: 10\+ Years
 



 Reports to: Founder
 



 Working days: 5 Days a Week (Mon\-Fri)
 



  





**About Bluecopa** 




  





 Bluecopa is building the AI\-native operating system for enterprise finance. Our platform runs intelligent workflows across order\-to\-cash, procure\-to\-pay, and record\-to\-report, with humans and AI working together to run the finance function rather than just report on it. Our customers are some of the most demanding, high\-volume organizations in the world. Our investors are top\-tier funds who bring real operating expertise to the companies they back.
 



  





 We have built this company brick by brick over four years. Hustle first, customer obsessed, technically ambitious. That energy got us here. We are now at the point where companies with real ambition make the step from fast\-growing to category\-defining. Raw hustle has to be joined by real organizational depth, without losing the drive that made it work in the first place.
 



  





**Why This Role, and Why Now?** 




  





 This is not a traditional HR role, and it is not a pure operational one by design.
 



  





 Bluecopa's next phase will be shaped by the people decisions we make from here. How we build our leadership bench. How we structure teams as the platform deepens. How we bring rhythm and clarity to a company that has so far run on the founding team's energy and conviction. These are some of the most consequential problems in the business right now, and we are looking for the person who wants to own them.
 



  





 You will be our
 **first dedicated People leader** 
 , building the people operating system for a scaling enterprise software company from first principles. If you have spent your career waiting for a mandate this big and this real, this is it.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




  





**Organization design and leadership depth.** 
 Partner with the founders to design how Bluecopa is structured as it scales, where leadership is strong, where the gaps are, and how we build the senior bench the next phase demands. \*This is the heart of the role.
 



  





**Operating rhythm and people metrics.** 
 Bring cadence and discipline to how the leadership team and the broader org operate. Build the input, output, and outcome metrics that let founders and investors see organizational health clearly and make people decisions on evidence.
 



  





**Rewards, policy, and operations.** 
 Build compensation and benefits frameworks and people policies that are simple, compliant, and employee\-friendly, and operationalize them cleanly across teams.
 



  





**Performance and growth.** 
 Establish our performance philosophy, goal\-setting and OKR frameworks, career paths, competency models, and succession planning. Define and create the systems that turn a talented team into high\-performing leaders.
 



  





**Culture and experience.** 
 Protect and evolve Bluecopa's essential character as we grow: the high ownership, accountability, and pace that define us today, while adding the structure that scale requires tomorrow. Design onboarding, engagement, and recognition that accelerate people rather than slow them down.
 



  





**Talent systems that scale.** 
 Design the hiring engine, including strategy, employer brand, candidate experience, and the metrics behind it, across Product, Engineering, GTM, and Customer Success. Build the machine and the team to run it.
 



  





**How You'll Work** 




  





 You'll own this function and run it with real independence. It's a build\-from\-scratch mandate, and you'll shape most of it on your own judgment. Where it counts, you won't be doing it alone. The biggest calls, like leadership structure, org design, and hard sequencing under constraint, are ones you'll think through directly with the founders, investors, and advisors, because they are calls the whole company has a stake in. That close interface with a seasoned founding team and experienced investors is one of the real privileges of this seat.
 



  





**Who You Are** 




  





 This role suits someone whose trajectory is still steep. If you're looking for a seat to settle into, this isn't it.
 



  





 \- 10\+ years in People, HR, or Talent, ideally through the Series A–D scaling journey of a fast\-growing technology company.
 



 \- Evidence you've consistently operated above your title, taken on scope before it was formally given, and earned the trust of senior leaders without positional authority.
 



 \- A builder who is genuinely energized by ambiguity and the absence of a playbook, not merely tolerant of it.
 



 \- Strong organizational\-design instinct and business acumen. You think in systems, and you can hold your own in a strategy conversation with founders.
 



 \- Excellent communication and coaching skills, and the judgment to know when to decide and when to escalate.
 



 \- Enterprise SaaS or B2B technology experience is highly valued.
 



  





**What Makes Someone Successful Here** 




  





 \- You build trust before you build process, and you add discipline without smothering the hustle that got us here.
 



 \- You balance genuine empathy with a high bar, and you use data without losing the human read.
 



 \- You're as comfortable designing an org with founders as you are onboarding a new joiner well.
 



 \- You have the ambition and self\-belief to grow with the company, and the humility to build the foundations first.
 



  





**Why Join Bluecopa** 




  





 You'll have the rare chance to
 **build a company, not just join one** 
 . Your work will shape every future hire, every leader, and every cultural decision. The systems you build now will define how Bluecopa operates for many years to come. You'll do it alongside an ambitious founding team, investors of genuine calibre, and seasoned advisors, at a company solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise software.
 



  





 If building a world\-class people organization from the ground up is the challenge you've been looking for,
 **we'd love to meet you. Or please reach out to people@bluecopa.com**

title: MSP Program Coordinator
description:
**Company Overview:** 




*Workspend is a leading global provider of contingent workforce management solutions for Fortune 500/Global 2000 clients. Workspend is one of the fastest growing companies in the industry and currently supports over 40 clients to manage their temporary workforce and total talent solutions. Workspend is an innovative company, and we are using the latest innovative technologies to disrupt the workforce industry.* 




  





**Job Summary:** 




 The Program Coordinator is responsible for supporting temporary/contingent workforce programs for our clients. The Coordinator is responsible for building and maintaining relationships with Hiring Managers and suppliers to support and manage the full lifecycle for the requisition process including requisition intake, shortlisting, Supplier sourcing management, onboarding, worker assignment management, time and expense, offboarding and reporting. The Program Coordinator acts as a talent advisor and strategic business partner to support our clients and ensure requisition fulfillment for quality talent in a timely manner. The role offers an excellent opportunity for someone to learn strong leadership skills and grow in their careers
 



  





**Responsibilities:** 



* Managing hiring manager relationships and at times interacting with client’s executive leadership to ensure all contingent labor needs are fulfilled.
* Managing the staffing and requisition fulfillment process – ensuring that the client’s needs are being met. Including, but not limited to:
* Assisting client managers during all stages of the contract labor acquisition process including: requisition intake, sourcing, candidate shortlisting and interviewing
* Document requirement intake conversations in appropriate database (VMS etc.)
* Discuss with HM agree upon expectations, timeframes, feedback, roles and responsibilities of everyone involved in the requisition fulfilment process
* Work with and communicate with staffing suppliers to make sure that proper feedback, projections, and critical communications are being relayed in a timely manner.
* Facilitation of on\-boarding and off\-boarding of contractors
* Maintain the VMS (vendor management system) with strong attention to details of staffing, hiring and on boarding process of the contingent workforce. This will include updating the system with rate changes, processing contract extensions, processing releases/terminations and updating other data as necessary.
* Work to identify new opportunities to expand client relationships by partnering with the delivery teams to provide proactive solutions to current and future challenges.
* Provide strong professional management of the contingent workforce to include, but not limited to, interviewing, screening, selection/deselection, orientation, supervision, coaching, counseling, and disciplinary actions up to and including releases/terminations based on client guidelines.
* Coach, manage and oversee performance of participating staffing suppliers
* Document all client/supplier reported issues and track resolution through to completion ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction
* Conduct supplier scorecard reviews, including performance discussions, metric adherence and strategic conversations
* Accurate and on\-time completion of reports on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis.
* Conduct new hire orientation with all prospective candidates per customer guidelines.
* Conduct regular meetings with the customer managers to ensure effective communication.
* Monitor and address issues and concerns with the contingent workforce quickly and effectively; escalate issues to management as needed.
* Assist with development of presentation and customer\-facing items (QBRs, Operational reviews, Dashboard reviews, other), with support from leader
* Assist with worker assignment management (cost center changes, extension of contract assignments etc.) to improve data integrity
* Liaison with managers, vendors and security department to ensure all necessary paperwork is completed and collected prior to starting assignments and at end of assignments
* Ensure all work orders are closed in the system with accurate finish reasons when notified of an end of assignment and appropriate departments are notified (i.e., security)
* Assist with the collection of company assets from vendors (laptop, badges, etc.)
* Work hand in hand with the program management team to ensure metrics, SLAs, and targets are driven with a vision and are being met.
* Serve as the professional representative of Workspend to the client – solving problems and diligently following up to ensure best in class service to the client.
* Work with the client to help identify departments, skill set categories, divisions and locations where Workspend’ s services could assist in cost savings, risk aversion and efficiencies.
* Participate in client meetings to review strategic initiatives and assist with PMO roadmap/initiatives



  





**Mandatory skills:** 



* Minimum 1\-2 years’ experience supporting clients for their temporary workforce hiring and management either for a temp/contingent staffing MSP or a temp staffing master vendor program.
* Experience in high volume coordination activities (interviewing, onboarding, etc.)
* Experience with MS Office (Excel, Word, PPT) and PC skills
* Able to work independently with minimal direction required for core daily responsibilities
* Medium level of direction needed for advanced responsibilities
* Excellent communication skills including client relationship management
* Detail oriented with strong analytical skills
* Should be a quick learner and motivation to continue to grow in your career.
* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent business experience preferred.
* Customer Focused



  





*Workspend is an EEOE. Workspend offers an entrepreneurial culture and endless opportunity to grow for the right and motivated individuals. Looking for candidates who are driven and are looking to grow to next level in their careers. Should be responsible and take ownership. Workspend offers an attractive compensation package and benefits that include health Insurance, flexible paid time off and other benefits.*

description:

 If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role
 **Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Global Capability Network India**
**Location\- Hyderabad and Bengaluru**
**Overview Of The Team**
* HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
* Employee Relations Advisory (ERA) team is accountable to deliver the Employee Relations strategy around Policies \& Procedures, Conduct and Concerns Management, Business Change and Transformation, People Risk and Governance, Employment Law and Litigation \& Industrial Relations by applying appropriate judgement in making decisions taken are compliant with local legislations and Group's guidelines that apply.
* This role will be part of the Employee Relations Advisory Team of Infrastructure that manages Employee Relations Advisory related aspects for Global Capability Networks across 8 countries supporting Global Capability Network in India comprising of c.30k employees and reports in Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Infrastructure.


**In This Role, You Will**
* Lead Employee Relations Advisory for Global Capability Network India, aligning the agenda with business strategy, workforce priorities, organisational culture, risk appetite and the broader People strategy. Provide strategic counsel and constructive challenge to HR and business leadership on complex employee, workforce and organisational matters, balancing employee experience, business needs, legal and regulatory considerations.
* Own the ER (Employee Relations) risk agenda by proactively identifying litigation, conduct and workforce risks; establish appropriate mitigation strategies and ensure risks remain within the organisation’s risk appetite.
* Lead the development, governance and continuous improvement of ER policies, frameworks and practices, ensuring alignment with Indian employment legislation, regulatory requirements, Group frameworks and evolving business needs.

* Lead the India approach to employment litigation and disputes, partnering with Internal Legal and external counsel on litigation strategy with clear accountability for outcomes. Provide strategic advice on workforce transformation and business change, outsourcing, operating\-model changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Provide guidance on Industrial Relations and employee representation matters, including the management of emerging industrial relations risks where applicable. Anticipate and interpret changes in Indian employment legislation, regulatory expectations and market practice, translating these into implications, recommendations and proactive changes to strategy, policies and business practices.
* Establish robust governance and oversight, providing senior leadership with meaningful trends, risk indicators, case insights and recommendations to support informed workforce decisions. Ensure appropriate quality assurance, consolidation and reporting of India ER activity, including material cases, risk themes, litigation, workforce change and service delivery metrics.

Oversee, track and monitor Employee Relations Advisory service delivery metrics and provide trends and insights to Entity, Regional and Global Governance Forums.
* Own the effectiveness of the India ER operating model, ensuring appropriate prioritisation, capacity, service standards, escalation mechanisms, quality assurance and consistent delivery of ER advisory services. Lead continuous improvement and simplification of ER processes, leveraging technology, data and innovative approaches to improve manager and employee experience, strengthen controls and increase the effectiveness of ER delivery.
* Build and lead a high\-performing Employee Relations team, developing capability in strategic advisory, employment law, investigations, workforce transformation, industrial relations, risk management and stakeholder influence. Coach and enable the ER Advisory Team, HRBPs and people managers to strengthen ER capability, improve manager effectiveness and promote consistent, fair and accountable practices. Build strong strategic partnerships with HRBPs (Human Resource Business partners), business leaders, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Reward and other specialist functions; represent Employee Relations in governance and leadership forums; embed ER considerations into organisational and workforce strategy; and role\-model the organisation’s leadership behaviours and values to support high performance, responsible leadership, employee trust and sustainable business outcomes.


**To Be Successful You Will**
* Post Graduation in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Law or related disciple, with 15\+ years of experience in progressive experience, including significant experience i.e., 10 years leading Employee Relations in a complex, large scale organization.
* Proven track record of leading an Employee Relations Advisory function, shaping ER strategy, policies, frameworks, and practices that enable business outcomes while maintaining appropriate employee, regulatory and reputational risk controls.
* Deep expertise in Indian employment, labor and industrial relations legislations, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, commercially sound ER strategies, policies and interventions.
* Strong experience managing complex and high\-risk ER issues, including investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, employee disputes, litigations, regulatory proceedings, industrial relations. Demonstrated expertise in advising on organizational transformation and workforce changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Strong risk and governance mindset, with the ability to identify emerging people, legal, regulatory, employee relations risks to establish appropriate controls and provide clear recommendations for active risk mitigation.
* Exceptional influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to consult, challenge and influence stakeholders (across levels) across HR, Business Legal, Compliance, Risk and other control functions to achieve balanced and sustainable outcomes.
* Strong commercial and business acumen with ability to understand business strategy, operating models and workforce priorities and translating them into pragmatic ER solutions.
* Good communication, judgement and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential matters with integrity, empathy and sound judgment.
* Strong leadership capability, including developing ER/ Advisory talent, building organizational capability, creating a high\-performance culture and establishing consistent ER standards across a complex organization.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and navigate complex, competing priorities, making sound and timely decisions with limited precedent while maintaining appropriate risk discipline.

description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 At ServiceNow, our technology makes the world work for everyone, and our people make it possible. We move fast because the world can’t wait, and we innovate in ways no one else can for our customers and communities. By joining ServiceNow, you are part of an ambitious team of change makers who have a restless curiosity and a drive for ingenuity. We know that your best work happens when you live your best life and share your unique talents, so we do everything we can to make that possible. We dream big together, supporting each other to make our individual and collective dreams come true. The future is ours, and it starts with you.
   

  

 With more than 7,700\+ customers, we serve approximately 85% of the Fortune 500®, and we're proud to be one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® and World's Most Admired Companies™.
   

  

 Learn more on Life at Now blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at ServiceNow.
   

  

 Unsure if you meet all the qualifications of a job description but are deeply excited about the role? We still encourage you to apply! At ServiceNow, we believe skills and experience are transferrable, and the desire to dream big makes for great candidates.
   

  

**What You Get To Do In This Role**
 Our Service Delivery team makes the world of work, work better for our employees. Using our own technology, we deliver an engaging employee experience, providing support to employees and managers across 27 countries. Partnering closely with our Global People stakeholders and Centers of Excellence, we create a strong and effective cross\-functional team. We learn from our employees’ interactions with us, and constantly evolve and enhance value.
   

  

 As a Program Lead for the Transformation \& Enablement team within the Global People Operations \& Service Delivery (HR Ops) organization, you will enable the Service Delivery team to execute at an elite level. You will drive rigor, discipline, and governance across multiple operating rhythms, with a specific focus on advisor readiness and consistent service quality. You will leverage the ServiceNow AI platform to develop a programmatic approach to enablement, building scalable, lasting resources to support enterprise initiatives, as well as own the training strategy for our global People Enablement Centers (PECs). This role sits at the intersection of program design, ServiceNow platform adoption, and AI technology — building the systems and infrastructure that allow delivery centers to ramp faster, perform more consistently, and scale skill development globally.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Own new\-hire onboarding program for global PECs, applying industry\-benchmarked instructional design and program management practices to reduce time\-to\-competency and improve skilling consistency at scale.
* Advance development and launch our advisor readiness application, partnering with operations and technical teams to capture, track, and report on training progress in a governance\-ready, auditable system, built on the ServiceNow platform.
* Design and execute a global training strategy supporting processes across the full employee lifecycle, in partnership with PEC management — sequence and refresh a calendar\-year curriculum that can be adapted to ongoing process optimization, journey types, and geographies.
* Thoughtfully and organically build AI into enablement program design and delivery — identifying where AI\-powered tools can accelerate content creation, customize onboarding paths, automate quality checks, or surface early\-warning signals in training data.
* Run the recurring monthly quality audit program, proactively coordinating with auditors to ensure timely completion, and translating findings into qualified improvement recommendations for PEC leadership and measurable delivery center performance gains. Maintain and drive enhancements to our audit process and application as needed.
* Leverage data and applications to proactively surface service delivery improvement opportunities, partner with operations leaders to diagnose bottlenecks, and drive measurable performance gains across PECs through targeted enablement and capability\-building initiatives.
* Reimagine enablement for business continuity and leadership readiness—evolving offerings into skill development pathways for enterprise proficiencies, such as organizational resilience, effective prioritization, and autonomous, data\-driven insights and decision\-making.
* Partner with Sr. Manager, T\&E and DT team to identify and drive Robotic Process Automation (RPA) use case development to automate manual operational tasks and reporting
* Bring perspective on how to structure and evolve onboarding, governance, and skill\-scaling programs, adapting proven practices to Operations \& Service Delivery’s operating model.


**What Are We Looking For**
 To excel in this role, you should demonstrate the following:
   

  

* High autonomy and comfort operating with ambiguity, translating strategic priorities into structured, executable programs.
* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent, cross\-functional initiatives independently. Effective prioritization with minimal direction and providing updates proactively.
* Practical experience applying AI capabilities to content creation or operational enablement.
* Hands\-on familiarity with the ServiceNow AI platform and proficiency in Citizen Development — able to design workflows and systems that work within the platform, not outside it.
* Strong operations background, with specific fluency in training and process governance.
* Experience performing or supporting process reviews and audits
* Comfort interpreting operational data to identify trends and opportunities.
* Excellent relationship\-building skills, with experience partnering across regions and business units toward a defined, shared outcome. You are known to accelerate alignment.


**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**
* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 1\-2 years’ experience developing or maintaining formal process documentation and performing process audits
* 2\+ years of demonstrated success managing cross\-functional stakeholder relationships, up to executive level
* 2\+ years of practical experience designing and/or delivering enablement materials (e.g. live training, process maps, Standard Operating Procedures, work instructions, training presentations) to global audiences
* 2\-4 years’ experience in HR operations or supporting multiple concurrent, complex HR projects in a matrixed environment
* Citizen Development certification
* Strong knowledge of enterprise\-approved AI technologies (e.g. Copilot, Claude, and Moveworks)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Previous experience in an HR Shared Services role
* Dedicated program management experience (responsible for end\-to\-end program delivery)
* Strong AI prompting skills
* Citizen Development proficiency (developed and/or launched one or more scoped applications on the ServiceNow AI platform)
* Experience working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, including in support of Shared Services
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience


 Additional Information
   

  

**Work Personas**

Learn more here. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

 We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

 For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.** 
 It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day.  **Workday HRIS Consultant**

 **Workday HCM, Compensation, and Security**

This role will partner closely with HR, Total Rewards, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improve employee experience, ensure data integrity, and support organizational growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Workday Configuration \& Administration**
* Configure, maintain, and optimize Workday HCM, Compensation, and Security modules.

**Compensation Management**

* Troubleshoot compensation\-related issues and provide timely resolutions.


**Security Administration**
* Configure and maintain domain and business process security policies.
* Manage role\-based security assignments and perform periodic security audits.
* Ensure compliance with organizational policies, privacy regulations, and audit requirements.
* Support security reviews, segregation\-of\-duty controls, and risk mitigation initiatives.


**Reporting \& Data Management**
* Develop, maintain, and enhance Workday reports, dashboards, and calculated fields.
* Ensure HR data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across Workday modules.
* Analyze workforce and compensation data to support business decision\-making.
* Support internal and external audit requests through accurate reporting and documentation.


**Stakeholder Collaboration**
* Partner with HR, Payroll, Compensation, Talent, and IT teams to identify system enhancement opportunities.
* Provide functional guidance and recommendations based on Workday best practices.
* Support global HR initiatives, system implementations, and organizational changes.
* Deliver end\-user support and training for Workday processes and functionality.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes through automation and system enhancements.
* Stay current with Workday releases and emerging HR technology trends.
* Participate in HR transformation and digitalization initiatives.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, or a related field.


**Experience**
* 3\-7 years of hands\-on experience supporting Workday HCM implementations and production support environments.
* Proven experience configuring and administering
+ Workday Core HCM
+ Workday Compensation
+ Workday Security

* Experience supporting global HR operations and complex organizational structures.
* Experience with Workday business processes, condition rules, calculated fields, and security frameworks.


**Technical Skills**
* Strong understanding of Workday security architecture, domains, business process security, and role assignments.
* Experience supporting merit, bonus, and compensation review cycles within Workday.
* Advanced reporting expertise using Workday Report Writer and calculated fields.
* Experience with EIBs, data loads, and mass data updates.
* Strong Excel skills including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and data analysis techniques.
* Exposure to HR technology automation and AI\-enabled solutions.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high\-quality solutions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Workday Pro or Workday Certification in HCM, Compensation, or Security.
* Experience supporting annual compensation planning cycles.
* Exposure to Workday Prism Analytics or People Analytics.
* Experience working in consumer products, retail, manufacturing, or global enterprise environments.
* Familiarity with Workday integrations, Studio, Core Connectors, and Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB).
* Knowledge of Agile project methodologies.
* Experience participating in Workday implementations, enhancement projects, or HR transformation initiatives.

If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
   

  

**How We Work**
 We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
   

  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance\-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best\-in\-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Combining purposeful in\-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.

 Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher\-Price, American Girl, Thomas \& Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
