description:
**Talent500 is hiring for one of its clients.** 




**About Brink’s:** 




 Brink’s is a global leader in secure logistics and cash management, operating in more than 50 countries. As the company evolves into a technology\-enabled, data\-driven organization, Brink’s is transforming how work is delivered across functions to create greater scale, consistency, and efficiency.
 



 At Brink’s, you will be part of a global team focused on driving operational excellence and supporting enterprise transformation. You will have the opportunity to build critical skills, collaborate with experienced professionals, and contribute to work that has real impact across the business. Brink’s is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people can grow, contribute, and build meaningful careers.
 



  





**About Global Shared Services Center, India:** 




 Brink’s Global Shared Services Center (GSS) in Hyderabad is a critical enabler of the company’s global transformation and operating model evolution. The center brings together specialized capabilities across Human Resources, Finance, Technology, and other enterprise functions to deliver integrated, end\-to\-end services that support global business priorities.
 



 The center is designed to enable standardized processes, scalable service delivery, and stronger cross\-functional collaboration. Teams in GSS partner closely with global stakeholders to drive efficiency, improve quality, design and scale next generation services, and deliver consistent outcomes across markets.
 



 Hyderabad offers the opportunity to work on complex, high\-impact initiatives, build global exposure, and contribute to the continued evolution of Brink’s operating model.
 



  





**Business Unit Description:** 




 This role sits within Communications and Change Management, a team that plays a critical role in enabling successful business transformation across Brink’s global organization.
 



 The function is responsible for leading change management, stakeholder engagement, communications, learning enablement, and adoption activities that help employees and leaders successfully transition to new processes, systems, operating models, and ways of working.
 



 As part of Brink’s global operating model, the team partners across business units, transformation programs, and corporate functions to drive readiness, adoption, and sustained business outcomes, helping the organization realize the full value of its strategic investments.
 



  





**What You’ll Be Doing (Position Summary):** 




 We are seeking a highly skilled Change Lead / Engagement Manager to support enterprise transformation initiatives by coordinating change management delivery, stakeholder engagement, and adoption activities across workstreams, functions, and regions. This role will partner closely with Transformation Office leaders, change managers, communications partners, functional teams, and delivery resources to ensure change activities are planned, coordinated, and executed with consistency and discipline.
 



 The successful candidate will help translate transformation priorities into practical change plans, support engagement with key stakeholders, and ensure that change management deliverables are integrated into project plans, governance cadences, and business readiness activities. In addition to hands\-on change delivery and execution, this role will provide day\-to\-day coordination and oversight for co\-located resources aligned to the change management function, including Multimedia and Learning and Development support. The Change Lead / Engagement Manager will help ensure these resources are appropriately prioritized, integrated into change plans, and delivering high\-quality outputs that support stakeholder engagement, training, communications, readiness, and adoption.
 



  





**Work Environment:** 




 At Brink’s, we enable a work environment that supports both performance and flexibility. Work arrangements, including on\-site and hybrid options, will be discussed during the interview process based on role requirements and business needs.
 



  





**How You’ll Succeed (Roles \& Responsibilities):** 




**Success in this role requires both strong execution and the ability to operate effectively in a global, evolving environment. You will:** 



* Support the development and execution of change management strategies and plans for enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Coordinate change management activities across assigned workstreams, including stakeholder analysis, change impact assessments, readiness assessments, engagement planning, and adoption support.
* Partner with change managers, communications leads, training partners, and functional teams to ensure change activities are aligned, sequenced, and integrated into overall project plans.
* Provide day\-to\-day coordination and work direction for co\-located Multimedia and Learning and Development resources supporting transformation change management delivery.
* Translate change management needs into clear creative, multimedia, learning, and enablement work requests, ensuring deliverables are aligned to stakeholder needs, project timelines, and adoption goals.
* Manage sequencing, priorities, dependencies, and review cycles across change, multimedia, and learning deliverables to support integrated execution.
* Review outputs from aligned support resources to ensure quality, consistency, usability, and alignment with Brink’s brand, transformation messaging, and change management standards.
* Facilitate stakeholder engagement activities, working sessions, and feedback loops to identify risks, surface adoption barriers, and support informed decision\-making.
* Maintain change management deliverables, trackers, status updates, and reporting materials to support Transformation Office governance.
* Support the development of leader and stakeholder engagement materials, including talking points, briefing documents, stakeholder maps, and meeting materials.
* Monitor change readiness, adoption indicators, and stakeholder sentiment, escalating risks and recommending mitigation actions as needed.
* Help ensure consistent application of change management frameworks, tools, templates, and ways of working across the transformation portfolio.
* Coordinate with offshore and local resources to support on\-time, high\-quality delivery of change management activities and deliverables.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement across the change management team and broader transformation partners.



  





**Experience:** 



* Bachelor’s degree in organizational change, communications, business administration, human resources, psychology, or a related field.
* 5 to 10 years of experience in change management, engagement management, consulting, transformation delivery, organizational effectiveness, or related roles.
* Proven experience supporting change management, stakeholder engagement, business transformation, or consulting delivery in a complex organization.
* Strong knowledge of change management principles, methodologies, tools, and deliverables.
* Strong project coordination and delivery management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information and support executive\-ready materials.
* Strong interpersonal and facilitation skills, with high emotional intelligence and the ability to build trusted relationships across functions and geographies.
* Experience working in global, matrixed environments and partnering with cross\-functional teams.
* Familiarity with transformation governance, change readiness, adoption measurement, and stakeholder management practices.

It’s why we’re committed to giving back to the communities where we live and work. If you're one of the super\-talented who thrive on change, aren't afraid to take risks and love to make a difference, come grow with us.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Lead the India Total Rewards and HR Shared Services function by designing and executing compensation and benefits programs, delivering efficient HR operations, and ensuring an exceptional employee experience. Partner with global Centres of Excellence (COEs), HR Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders to drive reward strategies, operational excellence, compliance, and people processes.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Lead the design, implementation, and governance of benefit programs for the India employee population, ensuring market competitiveness and alignment with global reward philosophy.
* Oversee benefits strategy, vendor management, policy design, and annual renewals while driving employee awareness and utilization of benefit programs.
* Manage annual and mid\-year compensation review cycles, including promotions, bonuses, and market adjustments in partnership with business leaders HRBPs and finance.
* Participate in compensation benchmarking and market analysis to support hiring, retention, and internal equity decisions.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition and HR Business Partners to provide compensation recommendations for new hires, promotions, transfers, short term assignments and organizational changes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable statutory, tax, and regulatory requirements related to compensation and employee benefits.
* Lead end\-to\-end HR operations including onboarding, offboarding, employee lifecycle management, payroll governance, HR documentation, and compliance with local labour regulations.
* Drive continuous improvement of HR processes and service delivery by establishing service standards, SLAs, and operational metrics.
* Develop and maintain HR policies, SOPs, governance frameworks, and process


 documentation to ensure consistency and compliance.
   

  

* Optimize HR technology platforms and workflows to improve efficiency, data quality, and employee experience.
* Ensure integrity of HR data across systems.
* Monitor and analyse key HR metrics including headcount, attrition, hiring, compensation, span of control, and employee experience to support business decision\-making.
* Partner with global HR COEs on HRIS enhancements, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support workforce planning, budgeting, and organizational changes through robust people analytics and reporting.


 Who you are
   

  

* Lead and support enterprise HR initiatives, policy implementations, and transformation projects that improve operational effectiveness and employee experience.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex employee relations and operational matters, partnering with Legal, HR Business Partners, and global stakeholders as required.

title: Delivery Manager - India
description:
Delivery Manager – India Business
 



**Location: Hyderabad, India** 




**Function:** 
 India Staffing Delivery
 



**Experience:** 
 10\+ years in domestic staffing, including 3\+ years in a delivery leadership role
 



  





 Job Summary
 



 The Delivery Manager – India Business will lead end\-to\-end recruitment delivery for requirements generated by business development and existing client accounts. The role is accountable for building a high\-performing delivery team, translating client demand into practical hiring strategies, improving speed and quality of fulfilment, and delivering a consistently strong stakeholder experience. The successful candidate will combine hands\-on knowledge of the India staffing market with disciplined operational management, data\-led decision\-making, and strong client partnership skills.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 


* **Delivery leadership:** 
 Own recruitment delivery across assigned India business accounts and ensure fulfilment against agreed priorities, timelines, quality standards, and service levels.
* **Team management:** 
 Lead, coach, and develop recruiters and team leads; set clear goals, allocate workloads, review performance, and build succession capability.
* **Recruitment strategy:** 
 Convert client requirements and workforce plans into sourcing, screening, assessment, and closure strategies suited to the India talent market.
* **Client partnership:** 
 Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and hiring managers, clarify requirements, manage expectations, and provide timely delivery updates and market insights.
* **Pipeline governance:** 
 Review requisition health, ageing, funnel conversion, recruiter productivity, offer status, joining risk, and fulfilment forecasts through regular operating reviews.
* **Quality and compliance:** 
 Maintain consistent screening, documentation, candidate communication, data privacy, and statutory or client\-specific compliance standards throughout the hiring lifecycle.
* **Stakeholder collaboration:** 
 Partner with business development, account management, sourcing, operations, HR, and finance teams to align capacity, priorities, commercials, and delivery commitments.
* **Process improvement:** 
 Identify bottlenecks, standardize effective practices, improve turnaround time, and use automation and recruitment technology to strengthen efficiency and candidate experience.
* **Escalation management:** 
 Anticipate delivery risks, resolve account or candidate issues promptly, and implement corrective actions to protect client relationships and business outcomes.
* **Market intelligence:** 
 Track talent availability, compensation trends, competitor hiring, location dynamics, and emerging skill demand across India, and convert insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Resource and budget management:** 
 Plan team capacity, manage delivery resources responsibly, and support profitability through efficient deployment and vendor usage.



 Key Success Measures
 


* Requisition fulfilment and closure ratio
* Time to shortlist, time to offer, and time to join
* Submission\-to\-interview, interview\-to\-offer, and offer\-to\-join conversion
* Ageing control and hiring forecast accuracy
* Client satisfaction, service\-level adherence, and escalation closure
* Recruiter productivity, quality, retention, and capability development
* Candidate experience and compliance accuracy



 Required Qualifications and Experience
 


* 10\+ years of experience in the India domestic staffing industry, with at least 3 years in a Delivery Lead, Delivery Manager, or comparable people\-management role.
* Demonstrated success managing full\-cycle recruitment delivery for multiple clients, accounts, business units, or high\-volume hiring programs.
* Strong understanding of India hiring practices, talent markets, sourcing channels, compensation dynamics, and applicable recruitment compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to lead recruiter teams, manage performance, coach for capability, and create accountability for outcomes.
* Strong client\-facing communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and expectation\-setting skills.
* Hands\-on experience with applicant tracking systems, job portals, sourcing platforms, recruitment analytics, and productivity tools.
* Ability to interpret recruitment data, identify root causes, and translate insights into practical actions.
* Sound commercial awareness, operational judgment, problem\-solving ability, and a strong orientation toward targets and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, human resources, or a related discipline.



 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience delivering IT, professional, or specialist staffing mandates in the Indian market.
* Exposure to managed services, recruitment process outsourcing, or large enterprise staffing programs.
* Experience managing distributed teams, multi\-location delivery, or rapid scale\-up assignments.
* Relevant postgraduate qualification or certification in human resources, recruitment, or project management.



 Leadership Attributes
 


* Ownership and accountability
* Customer focus and business partnership
* Data\-driven execution
* Clear communication and decisive leadership
* Adaptability in a fast\-paced environment
* Commitment to quality, integrity, and continuous improvement

 You will be joining the Real Estate and Workplace Operations (REWO) team within DoorDash's Finance Organization. We design, build, and operate inclusive, inspiring, and functional spaces that help employees do their best work, removing physical friction so teams can focus on what matters.
   

  

**About the Role**
 This role leads day\-to\-day Workplace and Facilities operations for our India site. You will drive efficient, employee\-focused operations on the ground, combining hands\-on operational expertise, vendor management, and team leadership to execute workplace strategy set by regional and global leadership. This is an overnight position that will also require working some weekends.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Lead and develop an insourced and outsourced Workplace and Facilities team on\-site, maintaining consistency in operations, service delivery, and employee experience.
* Set team goals aligned with organizational objectives; define clear performance metrics and hold the team accountable to them.
* Implement processes, playbooks, and initiatives that align with global workplace strategies and drive operational efficiency.
* Support space planning and allocation to accommodate evolving organizational needs, balancing functionality, employee experience, and cost.
* Coordinate office events to ensure they reflect company culture and deliver engaging, impactful experiences.
* Ensure all facilities meet local regulations, safety standards, and company policies; partner with cross\-functional teams to stay ahead of changing requirements.
* Partner with the Global Operations Center on crisis scenarios (natural disasters, evacuations, pandemics) and help the team execute business continuity plans.
* Manage vendor and contractor relationships for food, beverages, and essential services including contract administration, renewals, RFPs, and ongoing service level assessments.
* Support Real Estate on lease renewals, new builds, and renovations to ensure smooth day\-one operations.
* Use occupancy data, employee surveys, and spend analysis to inform local workplace decisions and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Manage the site's operating budget, including financial variance tracking and cost\-saving initiatives that maintain service quality.
* Support change management for workplace initiatives, communicating clearly and consistently with stakeholders throughout.
* Deliver regular updates to leadership on operations, project progress, and KPIs; maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders.
* Build collaborative relationships with cross\-functional partners, landlords, vendors, and contractors.
* Partner with the Sustainability Team to support environmental improvements at the office location.


**What We're Looking For**
* **Experience:** 
 Bachelor's degree and 3\+ years of Workplace leadership experience managing a team.
* **Leadership:** 
 Proven ability to mentor and develop team members, build cross\-functional partnerships, and foster a high\-performance culture. Comfortable setting goals, adapting quickly, and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
* **Communication:** 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills; able to present clearly across levels. Strong interpersonal skills and a relationship\-first approach.
* **Organization \& Execution:** 
 Highly organized and detail\-oriented; thrives in fast\-paced environments and ensures nothing falls through the cracks.
* **Problem Solving:** 
 Proactive and solutions\-oriented, with sound judgment and the ability to anticipate needs and act independently when required.
* **Vendor Management:** 
 Experience managing infrastructure service providers (custodial, catering, maintenance, etc.).
* **Project Management:** 
 Ability to manage cross\-functional projects from planning through completion, including office construction and renovation logistics.
* **Budget Management:** 
 Familiarity with budget tracking, financial planning, and procurement/sourcing processes.
* **Technology:** 
 Hands\-on with Google Suite, Jira, Coupa, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and Sigma. Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.
* **Flexibility:** 
 Able to work in\-office 5 days a week, travel \~10%, and work overnight shifts including weekends.
* **Industry Knowledge:** 
 Familiarity with workplace trends (hybrid/remote work, workplace design) and their impact on collaboration and productivity.


**About DoorDash**
 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
   

  

 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: HR
description:
Job Responsibilities
   

  

* Employee Recruitment \& Selection: Coordinate the recruitment process, including sourcing candidates, scheduling interviews, coordinating with department heads, and completing joining formalities.
* Employee Onboarding: Ensure proper onboarding and induction of new employees, including collection and verification of required documents and completion of joining formalities.
* Employee Records: Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee personal files, statutory documents, qualification records, experience certificates, and other HR\-related documentation.
* Attendance \& Leave Management: Monitor employee attendance, leave, late coming, absenteeism, and duty schedules in coordination with respective department heads.
* Payroll Coordination: Collect and verify attendance, leave, overtime, incentives, deductions, and other payroll\-related information and coordinate with the concerned team for timely salary processing.
* Staffing \& Manpower Planning: Coordinate with department heads regarding manpower requirements, vacancies, replacements, and staffing needs.
* Employee Engagement \& Grievance Handling: Receive and coordinate employee concerns and grievances and escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate authority.
* Hospital Policies \& Discipline: Ensure employees are aware of and comply with hospital policies, rules, code of conduct, attendance requirements, dress code, and disciplinary procedures.
* Performance Management: Coordinate employee performance evaluations, probation reviews, confirmation processes, appraisals, and related documentation.
* Training \& Development: Coordinate staff training, induction programs, mandatory training, competency assessments, and continuing education programs in consultation with department heads.
* Statutory \& Compliance Records: Maintain required HR and statutory records and coordinate compliance\-related documentation as applicable to the hospital.
* Employee Joining \& Exit Formalities: Ensure proper completion of joining, transfer, resignation, notice period, clearance, exit interview, and full\-and\-final settlement documentation.
* HR MIS \& Reports: Prepare and maintain HR reports related to manpower, attendance, absenteeism, attrition, recruitment, vacancies, training, and other HR metrics as required by management.
* Department Coordination: Coordinate with Nursing, Medical, Administration, Finance, Pharmacy, Laboratory, OT, CSSD, and other departments for HR\-related requirements and employee\-related matters.
* Staff Communication: Communicate management instructions, HR policies, circulars, notices, and important updates to employees in a timely manner.
* Employee Welfare: Support employee welfare initiatives, staff engagement activities, recognition programs, and other activities aimed at maintaining a positive work environment.
* Confidentiality: Maintain strict confidentiality of employee personal information, salary details, disciplinary records, and other sensitive HR information.
* HR Documentation \& Filing: Ensure systematic maintenance, updating, and safe custody of all HR files, registers, forms, and records.
* Recruitment Tracker: Maintain an updated recruitment tracker showing vacancies, candidates contacted, interview status, selection status, joining dates, and pending positions.
* Daily HR Operations: Handle day\-to\-day HR activities and provide timely updates to the Medical Superintendent/Hospital Administrator regarding important HR matters and pending issues.
* Staff Compliance Monitoring: Support management in monitoring compliance with hospital policies, staff requirements, mandatory documents, training requirements, and departmental instructions.
* Any Other Assigned Duties: Perform any other HR\-related duties and responsibilities assigned by the Medical Superintendent, Hospital Administrator, or authorized management.

title: Head of People Partnering, UK & Europe
description:
**About Tide**
 At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.
   

  

 Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.
   

  

 Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.
   

  

**Tide Facts**
* Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members across UK and India
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* Over 2,800 Tideans globally
* Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg


**About The Team**
 The
 **People Partnering team at Tide** 
 plays a pivotal role in driving business success by acting as strategic advisors and coaches to leaders at all levels. We provide expert guidance on organisational design, talent development, employee relations, and engagement, ensuring a positive and high\-performance culture. Embedded within the business, we use data\-driven insights to shape policies, pre\-empt workforce challenges, and lead high\-impact initiatives that enable Tideans to do work they love.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Head of People Partnering for UK \& Europe, you will:
   

  

* Design and implement a People Partnering strategy for the Tide’s UK \& Europe business that supports business objectives, enhances the employee experience, and fosters a high\-performance culture.
* Act as a strategic partner and advisor to the CEO of Tide’s UK \& Europe business and the UK \& Europe management team, providing expert guidance on organisational design, workforce planning, performance management, and employee relations.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of People Partners, ensuring they are equipped to support leaders and teams across various markets. Foster a culture of collaboration, learning, and continuous improvement.
* Support business leaders in driving organisational change, equipping them with the necessary people management tools to ensure smooth transitions and sustained business performance.
* Partner with business leaders and the Director of People Experience to drive employee engagement, interpret survey insights, and implement targeted action plans to enhance team satisfaction, retention, and productivity.
* Ensure HR policies and programs align with relevant employment laws and industry best practices while managing cross\-border employment complexities.
* Use HR analytics to inform people strategies, track key workforce metrics, and present actionable insights to business leaders.
* Oversee performance management, career development, and succession planning initiatives to build a strong talent pipeline and support internal mobility.
* Provide direct coaching to managers on complex employee relations matters, leadership development, and team effectiveness.
* Embed diversity, equity, and inclusion across all aspects of people partnering, ensuring it remains a core pillar of talent, engagement, and leadership strategies.
* Upholding and promoting the values of Tide in all interactions and decisions.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Progressive HR experience, including direct partnership with SVPs / C\-Suite leaders.
* Extensive experience partnering with cross\-cultural leadership teams.
* Experience with line management of both junior and senior People Partners.
* Good understanding of global HR practices and employment laws, particularly in India and various European countries.
* Strong client focus with outstanding judgement, critical thinking and analytical skills.
* Strong business acumen and the ability to align HR strategies with business goals.
* Exceptional leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Demonstrated ability to drive change at pace and foster a positive organisational culture.
* Ideally experience leading HR for a commercial and operations client groups (not essential).


**What You’ll Get In Return**
 Our location\-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:
   

  

* Competitive Compensation \- Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
* Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
* Health Insurance – Private family insurance with additional OPD coverage and top\-up options.
* Life \& Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
* Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
* Volunteering \& Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
* Learning \& Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
* WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
* Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
* Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
* Snacks \& Meals – Office perks with snacks, coffee, tea, and lunch (location dependent).


 TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING
   

  

 At Tide, we champion a
 **flexible workplace** 
 model that supports both in\-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.
   

  

 While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face\-to\-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team\-building, where we encourage regular in\-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.
   

  

 TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE
   

  

 At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently\-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.
   

  

 We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.
   

  

*At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.*
**Disclaimer**
 It Has Come To Our Attention That Individuals Or Agencies Are Falsely Claiming To Represent Tide And Are Reaching Out To Candidates Regarding Job Opportunities. Please Be Aware That
   

  

* Tide does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process.
* All official Tide job opportunities are listed exclusively on our Careers Page and applications should be submitted through this channel.
* Communication from Tide will only come from an official @tide.co email address.
* Tide does not work with agencies or recruiters without prior formal engagement, and we do not authorize third parties to make job offers on our behalf.


*If you are contacted by anyone misrepresenting Tide or requesting payment, please treat it as fraudulent and report it to us immediately at talent@tide.co
   

  

 Your safety and trust are important to us, and we are committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process.*
**Tide leverages AI to enhance our hiring experience. You can read more about how we use AI in our recruitment process in our AI Policy.**
**Your personal data will be processed by Tide for recruitment purposes and in accordance with* 
*Tide's Recruitment Privacy Notice* 
*.**

title: AVP - Employee Relations and Compliances
description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**
 At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.
   

  

 Join us as we create something extraordinary together.
   

  

**The AVP – Employee Relations and Compliance** 
 is responsible for developing, governing, and executing the employee relations and HR regulatory compliance framework for the India GCC. This role ensures adherence to applicable labour and employment laws, statutory obligations, employee relations processes, workplace investigations, and compliance governance requirements.
   

  

 The incumbent will serve as the compliance subject matter expert and governance lead, partnering closely with Legal, Payroll, HR Operations, Facilities, Procurement, external labour compliance vendors, and business leaders to mitigate risk, maintain audit readiness, and ensure an equitable, compliant, and positive employee experience.
   

  

 The role will be accountable for labour compliance oversight, regulatory monitoring, statutory inspections, compliance audits, policy governance, employee grievance management, disciplinary processes, and employee relations strategy across the India organization.
   

  

**Core Responsibilities**
* Regulatory Compliance Governance


 –Own and lead the end\-to\-end employment and labour compliance framework for the India GCC.
   

  

 –Ensure compliance with applicable Central and State employment laws, labour regulations, and statutory obligations.
   

  

 –Establish governance mechanisms for monitoring compliance obligations, statutory filings, registrations, renewals, notices, record maintenance, and payments.
   

  

 –Build and maintain a compliance calendar and compliance dashboard covering all employment\-related statutory requirements.
   

  

 –Monitor regulatory changes and assess business impact, ensuring timely implementation of new compliance requirements.
   

  

 –Drive compliance awareness and training programs for People leaders and employees.
   

  

 –Act as the primary compliance escalation point for labour law matters.
   

  

* Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance Management


 –Oversee compliance with employment related legislation
   

  

 –Ensure statutory filings, registrations, renewals, inspections, notices, and returns are completed accurately and within timelines.
   

  

 –Partner with Payroll and HR Operations to ensure all payroll\-linked statutory requirements are met.
   

  

* Employee Relations \& Workplace Governance


 –Develop and execute the Employee Relations strategy for the GCC.
   

  

 –Lead employee grievance resolution, disciplinary actions, misconduct investigations, workplace complaints, and conflict management.
   

  

 –Drive fair, consistent, and legally compliant employee relations processes.
   

  

 –Support leaders with performance\-related employee matters, conduct concerns, workplace disputes, and behavioral issues.
   

  

 –Ensure compliance with internal policies, code of conduct requirements, and ethical standards.
   

  

 –Partner with Legal where required on complex employee matters and litigation risks.
   

  

 –Lead workplace investigations and ensure appropriate documentation, governance, and closure.
   

  

* Compliance Vendor \& Regulatory Relationship Management


 –Manage relationships with external labour compliance vendors and legal advisors.
   

  

 –Oversee labour law registrations, statutory record maintenance, compliance audits, regulatory filings, and labour inspection support through vendors.
   

  

 –Coordinate responses to government authorities, inspectors, labour departments, and other regulators.
   

  

 –Monitor vendor performance through SLAs, audit outcomes, compliance metrics, and governance reviews.
   

  

 –Serve as the internal liaison for all labour compliance related regulatory interactions.
   

  

* Audit, Risk \& Controls


 –Lead labour compliance audits and compliance self\-assessments.
   

  

 –Ensure organizational readiness for internal audits, regulatory inspections, external audits, and diligence exercises.
   

  

 –Conduct risk assessments and develop mitigation strategies for emerging compliance risks.
   

  

 –Develop controls to ensure sustainable compliance adherence.
   

  

 –Drive corrective action tracking and closure of audit observations.
   

  

 –Maintain evidence repositories and statutory documentation for audit purposes.
   

  

* Policy Governance \& Employee Experience


 –Own policy governance for employment\-related policies and procedures.
   

  

 –Review, update, and implement policies to align with legislative and organizational requirements.
   

  

 –Ensure compliance requirements are embedded into employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, transfers, promotions, leave management, separations, contractor management, and workforce engagement.
   

  

 –Partner with business and People leaders to maintain a positive employee experience while ensuring compliance and risk mitigation.
   

  

* Reporting, Analytics \& Governance Forums


 –Develop compliance dashboards and executive reporting mechanisms.
   

  

 –Provide regular updates to GCC Leadership and People Leadership teams on compliance status, risks, audits, investigations, and corrective actions.
   

  

 –Use compliance and employee relations data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Master’s degree in law, Employment Law, Labour Relations, Human Resources, or related discipline.
* Strong understanding of Indian labour laws and employment compliance and regulatory frameworks.
* Strong knowledge of employee relations and workplace governance practices
* Experience managing employment compliance audits, investigations, and labour inspections.
* Certifications in Labour Laws, Compliance, Industrial Relations, or Compliance Management are preferred.


**Preferred Experience**
 –15\+ years of experience in HR Compliance, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, HR Operations, or Industrial Relations.
   

  

 –Experience in BFSI GCC, multinational corporations, or regulated environments is strongly preferred.
   

  

 –Experience working with external compliance and payroll vendors.
   

  

 –Demonstrated experience managing labour inspections, audits, regulatory inquiries, and investigations.
   

  

 –Strong experience designing scalable compliance governance frameworks.
   

  

**Core Competency \& Behavioural Description**
* Regulatory Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of labour laws, statutory requirements, regulatory frameworks, and compliance governance.
* Employee Relations: Strong capability in grievance management, investigations, disciplinary processes, and workplace conflict resolution.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, mitigate, and monitor compliance and employee relations risks proactively.
* Audit \& Controls: Experience designing compliance controls and driving audit readiness.
* Stakeholder Management: Ability to partner effectively with business leaders, legal teams, payroll teams, regulators, and external vendors.
* Policy Governance: Strong capability in developing, reviewing, and implementing policies and compliance frameworks.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to use compliance data and people analytics to drive decisions and identify emerging risks.
* Communication \& Influence: Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to influence leaders at all levels.
* Investigation \& Judgment: Demonstrated capability to conduct impartial investigations and make sound risk\-based decisions.

title: Payroll Vendor Manager, Amazon Global Payroll team
description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Payroll team within Amazon Finance Operations (FinOps) is a fast\-paced, team\-focused, dynamic environment. Our mission is to pay employees accurately and on time, every time, whilst keeping our costs controlled and complying with all regulatory requirements. The Amazon Payroll team is looking for an energetic, enthusiastic relationship manager with outstanding analytical, negotiation, and project management skills to join our Vendor Management team.
   

  

 The Payroll Vendor Manager is responsible for payroll vendor selection, and vendor management across all countries. This position will help oversee the performance of payroll service providers (vendors) and keep all agreements current. The incumbent is required to build strong relationships with Legal, Finance Operations, Tech, Compliance, HR, and regional payroll operations teams.
   

  

 This broad role is not only a relationship management role, it also focuses on Operational Excellence by partnering with Lean Six Sigma Black Belt team members to support continuous improvement of Amazon processes, aligning them with customer requirements, and delivering positive impacts in controllership, quality, and cost savings. This role may expand beyond the payroll space to support internal partners in FinOps and HR as needed. This position will initially have no direct reports.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To**
* Supporting the management of payroll vendor selection.
* Supporting market research activities.
* Supporting the negotiation and maintenance of contracts, ensuring reduction of cost per pay slip and alignment with Amazon's compliance and control requirements.
* Assisting and participating in vendor meetings as required.
* Analyzing and developing vendor performance data to support vendor governance.
* Analyzing vendor cost and cost improvement opportunities, monitoring monthly spending patterns, and identifying exceptions and areas for potential improvement.
* Deep diving customer pain points in a country and making recommendations for scalable solutions.
* Responding to escalations in a timely manner
* Supporting continued development of materials, techniques, and metrics to identify opportunities to improve VM tools, systems, and processes.
* Building and maintaining knowledge management tools such as wikis and shared drives.
* Training and mentoring stakeholders in vendor\-related processes.


**Key Skills Required**
* Experience in payroll, HRO, or BPO services, account management, process improvement, procurement, contract negotiation, and creation. Ability to invent and simplify processes, adopt AI tools to drive efficiency, and willingness to learn the payroll cycle and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Communication, problem\-solving, process improvement, stakeholder management, negotiation skills, and experience leveraging AI tools for operational improvement.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related field
* 3\+ years of vendor management, or 3\+ years of relevant discipline work experience
* 3\+ years of data analysis work and leveraging analytics to make decisions experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Experience with advanced use of Excel and using statistical analysis applications, or experience in vendor management
* 3\+ years of vendor management, or 2\+ years of relevant discipline work experience
* 3\+ years of experience in vendor management, procurement, contract negotiation, or account management


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in payroll operations
* Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
* Experience delivering Lean/Six Sigma projects such as Kaizens, Greenbelts, and continuous improvement initiatives, this should include needs assessment, business case creation, scope definition, project planning and project implementation
* Experience in creating process improvements with automation and analysis, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes
* Experience communicating results to senior leadership, or experience in identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan
* Master's degree (MBA or related discipline)
* Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
* Experience with end\-to\-end project management, or experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround
* Experience building and scaling knowledge management systems (wikis, runbooks, shared repositories).

title: Benefits Manager
description:
**Company Description**
 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI\-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
   

  

 Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an individual contributor to join our Total Rewards team as Benefits Manager, India. You will be the local expert on all India benefits matters, executing on the regional strategy and delivery of employee benefits programs.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring expertise in India's statutory and supplemental benefits landscape, strong executive presence, and the ability to influence decision making in a matrixed global organization. You will report to the Director, EMEA/APJ Benefits and work under the strategic direction of the Senior APJ Benefits Manager.
   

  

**Regional Strategy \& Global Partnership**
* Serve as the India benefits manager: act as the India expert, providing the APJ Lead with strategic market insights that directly inform regional benefits philosophy, design decisions, and policy frameworks. **About the Team**
 Our Total Rewards \- International Benefits team is a truly global team, with members based across the USA, UK, Hungary, and Finland, supporting benefits across our Wolt, Deliveroo and DoorDash brands, working together to deliver excellent, compliant benefits programs across every market we operate in.  We're looking for a Global Benefits Specialist to join our Total Rewards \- International Benefits team on a 12\-month Fixed Term Contract based in India. * Support benefits enrollment cycles and drive improvements to administration processes and systems (preferably Workday).

* You have working knowledge of benefits compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions, including India.
* You're familiar with HRIS platforms (Workday preferred) and understand how benefits processes integrate with SaaS HR systems.
* You're highly organized with exceptional attention to detail, comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.

title: IT Project Management Advisor
description:
**India T\&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:** 
 385948
   

  

 NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.
   

  

 We are currently seeking a IT Project Management Advisor to join our team in Hyderabad, Telangana (IN\-TG), India (IN).
   

  

**Job Description – Capacity \& Fulfilment Lead**
**Role:** 
 Capacity \& Fulfilment Lead
   

  

**Experience:** 
 12\+ Years
   

  

**Domain:** 
 Healthcare – Mandatory
   

  

**Coverage:** 
 Cross\-Portfolio Support
   

  

**Engagement:** 
 Enterprise Healthcare Customer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad(Preferred)/Metro locations where we have NTT DATA Office presence
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced
 **Capacity \& Fulfilment Lead** 
 with 12\+ years of experience to lead capacity planning, demand fulfilment, and resource optimization across multiple portfolios supporting a strategic healthcare customer.
   

  

 The role will provide
 **cross\-portfolio visibility and governance of demand, capacity, supply, and fulfilment** 
 , working closely with delivery leaders, portfolio/program managers, workforce management, talent acquisition, and other enabling functions. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring that current and forecasted resource requirements are understood, planned, and fulfilled in alignment with business priorities and delivery commitments.
   

  

 Strong experience working in the
 **Healthcare domain is mandatory** 
 , along with demonstrated expertise in capacity planning, resource/workforce management, demand forecasting, fulfilment governance, and stakeholder management in a large\-scale IT services or technology environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Capacity Planning \& Demand Management
   

  

* Lead capacity and resource planning across multiple portfolios, programs, and delivery teams supporting the healthcare customer.
* Consolidate and analyze current and future demand across portfolios to provide an integrated view of resource requirements.
* Develop short\-, medium\-, and long\-term capacity forecasts based on project pipelines, business priorities, ramp\-ups, ramp\-downs, and anticipated demand.
* Identify capacity gaps, excess capacity, skill shortages, and potential fulfilment risks proactively.
* Partner with portfolio and delivery leaders to validate demand forecasts and resource requirements.
* Drive proactive capacity planning rather than reactive resource fulfilment.


 Fulfilment Management
   

  

* Own and govern the end\-to\-end resource fulfilment process across the account/portfolio landscape.
* Track open demands, ageing, fulfilment status, critical positions, and upcoming resource requirements.
* Coordinate with internal workforce/resource management teams, Talent Acquisition, subcontracting/vendor teams, and delivery organizations to fulfil demand.
* Establish prioritization mechanisms for critical and competing resource demands.
* Drive timely closure of resource requirements while balancing skills, location, cost, availability, and delivery timelines.
* Identify fulfilment bottlenecks and implement corrective actions and escalation mechanisms.


 Cross\-Portfolio Governance
   

  

* Establish a consistent capacity and fulfilment governance model across portfolios.
* Provide leadership with a consolidated view of demand, supply, fulfilment, utilization, and associated risks.
* Facilitate regular capacity and fulfilment reviews with portfolio, delivery, and account leadership.
* Ensure alignment between portfolio\-level requirements and overall account/customer priorities.
* Identify opportunities for resource sharing and redeployment across portfolios to improve utilization and minimize external hiring.
* Manage dependencies and competing resource requirements across programs.


 Workforce Optimization
   

  

* Drive effective utilization of available resources through proactive deployment and redeployment.
* Identify upcoming roll\-offs and facilitate early mapping of resources to future requirements.
* Support workforce pyramid, location, skill\-mix, and cost optimization initiatives.
* Partner with leadership to identify strategic skill requirements and capability gaps.
* Provide inputs into hiring, cross\-skilling, upskilling, and workforce transformation plans.
* Reduce fulfilment lead times and improve internal fulfilment wherever feasible.


 Healthcare Domain Alignment
   

  

* Apply an understanding of the Healthcare industry and healthcare technology landscape when assessing resource and capability requirements.
* Understand delivery considerations associated with healthcare customers, including regulatory, security, privacy, compliance, and business\-critical environments.
* Work effectively with teams supporting healthcare business functions, platforms, applications, data, digital transformation, infrastructure, and related technology services.
* Ensure workforce and capacity strategies are aligned with customer priorities and healthcare\-specific delivery requirements.


 Reporting, Analytics \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Develop and maintain dashboards covering key metrics such as:
+ Demand vs. capacity
+ Fulfilment rate
+ Open and ageing demands
+ Time to fulfil
+ Resource utilization
+ Bench/available capacity
+ Upcoming roll\-offs
+ Skill gaps
+ Internal vs. external fulfilment

* Use data and trend analysis to anticipate capacity constraints and recommend actions.
* Drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of capacity and fulfilment processes.
* Present actionable insights, risks, and recommendations to senior account and delivery leadership.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 12\+ years of overall professional experience, preferably within IT services, consulting, technology delivery, or large\-scale managed services organizations.
* 8\+ years of significant experience in capacity planning, resource management, workforce management, demand management, or fulfilment management.
* Healthcare domain experience is mandatory.
* 5\+ years of demonstrated experience supporting large healthcare customers or healthcare technology environments.
* 5\+ years of proven experience managing resource demand and capacity across multiple portfolios/programs simultaneously.
* Strong understanding of IT delivery models, resource pyramids, skill planning, utilization, and workforce optimization.
* Experience working with delivery leadership, account management, HR/workforce management, Talent Acquisition, and vendor organizations.
* Ability to analyze complex demand and capacity data and translate it into actionable recommendations.
* Strong governance, planning, analytical, and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to work with senior leadership.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed, and geographically distributed organization.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience supporting large enterprise healthcare accounts in an IT services/consulting environment.
* Experience managing workforce/capacity across multiple technology areas such as applications, cloud, infrastructure, data \& analytics, digital, testing, cybersecurity, and managed services.
* Familiarity with workforce/resource management platforms and enterprise reporting tools.
* Experience with advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics/reporting solutions.
* Experience establishing or transforming capacity and fulfilment governance processes.
* Exposure to global delivery models, including onsite/offshore/nearshore workforce planning.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strategic Capacity Planning
* Demand Forecasting \& Fulfilment
* Cross\-Portfolio Resource Management
* Healthcare Domain Knowledge
* Workforce Planning \& Optimization
* Resource Utilization Management
* Stakeholder \& Leadership Management
* Data\-driven Decision Making
* Governance \& Risk Management
* Problem Solving \& Escalation Management
* Executive Communication

**ABOUT DARWINBOX** 




  





 Darwinbox is Asia's fastest\-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 900\+ global enterprises to manage their 2\.5 million\+ employees across 116\+ countries.
 



  





 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday. The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, Swiggy, DLF, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
 



  





 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
 



  





**ROLE OVERVIEW** 




  





 We are looking for an experienced and strategic professional to join our Human Resources team as Manager, Talent Management. This is an international HRBP role, partnering with business teams across MENA, India, and Southeast Asia, and shall naturally involve travel to these geographies.
 



  





 The role involves both advisory and delivery responsibilities, and the person will work closely with Directors and VPs as a thought partner on people strategy while also owning the design and execution of talent programs.
 



  





 The scope of work spans talent development, careers, performance management, and org design. The expectation is that programs and interventions will be designed keeping the overall organizational strategy in mind, and not as standalone HR initiatives.
 



  





 The person in this role is expected to identify what needs to be built, think through how it connects to where the organization is headed, and then deliver it. Prior experience in product or technology companies is preferred given the nature of the environment. Having worked in client\-facing or product roles is an added advantage, as it brings a useful perspective on how people, processes, and business outcomes interconnect.
 



  





 Because Darwinbox is an HCM solutions company, the broader HR community here, both within the People team and across the business, carries a high level of HR functional knowledge. The expectation for HR expertise in this role is accordingly high.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  





**International HR Business Partnering** 



* Partner with Directors and VPs across MENA, India, and SEA on people priorities, providing advisory support on talent, org structure, and workforce planning.
* Understand and navigate the business and cultural context across geographies to ensure that HR interventions are relevant and effective.
* Build credible working relationships with senior stakeholders that allow for ongoing, substantive dialogue on people matters.



**Talent Strategy and Program Design** 



* Develop and implement talent management strategies that are aligned to the organization's overall direction and business objectives.
* Design programs across the talent lifecycle including development, careers, performance, engagement, and succession.
* Ensure that programs are built for scale and sustainability, not just for immediate needs, and that they can evolve as the organization grows.



**Performance Management** 



* Design and manage the performance management process, including goal setting, evaluation frameworks, calibration, and career development planning.
* Work with business leaders to strengthen performance culture and improve individual and team productivity.
* Use data to track effectiveness of performance interventions and make informed recommendations.



**Learning and Development** 



* Identify learning needs across the organization and build development programs that address capability gaps at individual and team levels.
* Design career development frameworks and learning pathways that are connected to organizational growth and employee progression.
* Create an environment where continuous learning is treated as an integral part of how work gets done.



**Succession Planning** 



* Build and maintain a succession planning process to identify and develop internal talent for critical and leadership roles.
* Work with business leaders to map high\-potential employees and create structured development paths for them.



**Employee Engagement and Retention** 



* Develop and execute engagement programs that are relevant across international markets and contribute to a positive and inclusive workplace.
* Implement approaches to improve retention, employee well\-being, and overall job satisfaction.
* Use engagement data to have meaningful conversations with business leaders and drive action.



**Org Design** 



* Support organizational design conversations including structure, spans, roles, and team effectiveness.
* Partner with leadership to assess org health and recommend changes that improve performance and agility.



**Data and Reporting** 



* Use HR data and analytics to measure the impact of talent programs and make evidence\-based decisions.
* Provide regular reporting to senior management on key HR metrics and the outcomes of ongoing initiatives.



  





**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** 




  





**Education and Background** 



* Master's degree in Human Resources or a related field.
* 5 to 7 years of HR experience, with meaningful exposure to talent management and HR business partnering.
* Prior experience in product or technology companies is strongly preferred.
* Having worked in client\-facing or product\-facing capacities is an advantage, as it brings applied understanding of how business and people outcomes are connected.
* International HR or cross\-geography business partnering experience is preferred. Exposure to MENA, India, or SEA markets is a plus.



**Skills and Competencies** 



* Strong understanding of talent management practices including performance, learning and development, succession, org design, and engagement.
* Ability to work effectively with senior leaders, provide well\-reasoned advice, and influence decisions without direct authority.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into meaningful insights and recommendations.
* Good working knowledge of HR practices, employment frameworks, and regulatory considerations across multiple geographies.
* Clear and effective communicator, both in writing and in conversation.

 Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
   

  

 Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting\-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Global Process Owner (GPO) – Hire to Retire (H2R) you will be accountable for shaping and governing the end\-to\-end design, and continuous improvement of the global H2R process landscape. The role ensures standardisation, simplification, scalability, and business\-alignment across the employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition through onboarding, performance, development, mobility, and offboarding.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of enabling an exceptional employee experience while ensuring operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with Reckitt’s talent strategy. You will collaborate with HR Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global People Services (Shared Services), IT\&D, and other Global Process Owners in Global business services to drive process design, technology enablement, and continuous improvement across the full hire\-to\-retire value chain.
   

  

 Note: This role is not responsible for running day\-to\-day HR Shared Services operations. Instead, the GPO partners with Global People Services to deliver process improvements, automation, and simplification across all markets, ensuring operational execution aligns with process design and governance standards.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the global end\-to\-end H2R process strategy, standards, and governance framework
* Lead global design authority for H2R processes including hiring, onboarding, core HR operations, payroll, time \& attendance, and offboarding
* Champion process harmonization and digitization across markets, in partnership with HR, IT, and GBS
* Identify and deliver transformation opportunities that improve employee experience and operational performance
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, policy, and data privacy requirements across the H2R process landscape
* Drive adoption and optimization of H2R platforms (e.g., Workday, ServiceNow, payroll solutions)
* Monitor process performance and drive continuous improvement through KPIs and feedback loops


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Deep understanding of the HR function and full employee lifecycle, with extensive experience designing and leading global H2R processes in a multinational company
* Demonstrated success in process transformation, automation, and employee experience enhancement. Proven experience as a H2R GPO or Head of HR Shared Services operations preferred
* Hands\-on experience with global HR technologies (Workday, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ATS, payroll systems)
* Experience working in or closely with a Global Business Services or Shared Services model
* Demonstrated expertise in process ownership, transformation, and governance
* Proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders across functions and regions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven mindset
* Strong exposure to GBS ramp\-up and mature environments, with a track record of scaling operations and evolving processes
* FMCG or other high\-volume, fast\-paced industry background preferred


 The skills for success
   

  

* Global Process Design
* Hire to Retire
* HR Operations
* HRIS Platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Payroll \& Time Management
* Employee Experience Design
* Process Transformation
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* GBS Collaboration


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

* Onboarding

* Job changes and transfers

* Rewards, Payroll \& Benefits
* Learning \& Talent

* Maintain accurate documentation of activities, action items, and project decisions.


 Tools \& Technology
   

  

* Utilize Microsoft Excel for data analysis, validation, reconciliation, and reporting activities.
* Prepare presentations and status updates using Microsoft PowerPoint.
* Leverage Microsoft Office Suite and collaboration tools to support project execution.
* Navigate HR applications and systems to retrieve, review, and validate employee information.


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3\+ years of experience in HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Data Management, HRIS, or related functions.
* Experience supporting HR transformation, separation, divestiture, M\&A, spin\-off, split, or similar organizational change projects is preferred.
* Good understanding of employee data structures, employee files, and HR data management practices.
* Strong knowledge of HR processes including onboarding, offboarding, employee records administration, and workforce management.

* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage priorities across multiple stakeholders and deadlines.


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality

**Role:** 
 HR Executive
 



**Location:** 
 Hyderabad II Plant
 



**Qualification:** 
 MBA/PGDM in HR / MSW / MHRM or equivalent
 



**Experience:** 
 3–6 Years

 Experience in manufacturing / engineering / automobile / industrial products / process industries with hands\-on exposure to plant HR operations, employee relations, contract labour and statutory compliance.

 To manage day\-to\-day HR operations at the manufacturing plant, ensure effective employee engagement and manpower deployment, maintain statutory compliance, and support business and plant requirements through effective HR practices.

**A. HR Operations**




  





 \- Manage day\-to\-day HR activities at the plant.
 



 \- Maintain employee master data, personal files and HR records.
 



 \- Handle attendance, leave, shift and manpower\-related processes.
 



 \- Coordinate payroll inputs including attendance, overtime, incentives, deductions and other HR inputs.
 



 \- Address employee queries and resolve HR\-related issues.
 



  





**B. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning**




  





 \- Coordinate recruitment for plant positions, including operators, technicians, staff and executives.
 



 \- Prepare manpower requisitions and coordinate with recruitment agencies.
 



 \- Conduct preliminary screening and coordinate interviews.
 



 \- Ensure timely joining and onboarding of new employees.
 



 \- Monitor manpower requirements against approved manpower plans.
 



  





**C. Employee Relations**




  





 \- Maintain healthy employee\-management relations.
 



 \- Handle employee grievances and disciplinary matters in coordination with the HR Head.
 



 \- Conduct employee interaction meetings and shop\-floor visits.
 



 \- Support disciplinary proceedings and documentation as per company policy.
 



 \- Monitor absenteeism, attrition and employee concerns.
 



  





**D. Contract Labour Management**




  





 \- Manage contract labour deployment and documentation.
 



 \- Coordinate with contractors regarding manpower, attendance and statutory requirements.
 



 \- Verify contractor compliance documents.
 



 \- Monitor contract labour attendance, wages and statutory benefits.
 



 \- Support contractor audits and compliance reviews.
 



  





**E. Statutory Compliance**




  





 \- Support compliance under applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
 



 \- Maintain statutory registers, records and returns.
 



 \- Coordinate PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund and other applicable compliances.
 



 \- Support labour inspections and statutory audits.
 



 \- Ensure compliance related to working hours, overtime, leave and employment records.

 \- Coordinate the performance appraisal process.
 



 \- Support identification of training needs.
 



 \- Prepare and monitor training calendars.
 



 \- Maintain training records and effectiveness evaluation.
 



 \- Coordinate induction and employee development programs.

 \- Plan and coordinate employee engagement activities.
 



 \- Support welfare initiatives, celebrations and employee communication.
 



 \- Coordinate health check\-ups, awareness programs and welfare activities.
 



 \- Promote employee participation and positive workplace culture.

 \- Prepare daily/weekly/monthly HR reports.
 



 \- Track manpower, absenteeism, overtime, attrition, recruitment and other HR KPIs.

**I. Safety \& Plant Coordination**
