title: Head of Human Resources
description:
***We Are Hiring: Head of Human Resources***




  





**About Elahé** 




 For 30 years, Elahe has been part of Hyderabad's luxury fashion scene, bringing India's finest couture and ready\-to\-wear to discerning clients.
 



 Today, One Elahe LLP brings together seven businesses: Elahe, Elahe Urban, Gallery 476, Oorja, Elahe Online, Amrapali, and Sabyasachi. Its 150\+ strong team spans retail and styling, tailoring and craftsmanship, online, and operations.
 



  





***Location: Hyderabad***




  





**About the Role** 




 As Head of Human Resources, you will be the group's dedicated HR leader. Your first priority is hiring: making sure every business has the right people, at the right time. Alongside that, you will build the HR function from the ground up, including its policies, processes, and eventually its team.
 



 The role calls for a recruiter's instinct and a builder's discipline in equal measure.
 



  





***What you'll do:***




  





***HIRING ACROSS ALL BUSINESSES:***



* Own end\-to\-end hiring for all seven businesses, including sales associates and stylists, store managers, tailors and karigars, the online team, and back\-office roles.
* Work with the founders and business leads to plan headcount and anticipate hiring needs ahead of seasons, launches, and new openings.
* Build reliable sourcing channels, including job portals, fashion and design institutes, referrals, and local networks for skilled craftspeople.
* Run screening, interviews, reference checks, and offers, giving every candidate a fast and polished experience.
* Write and maintain clear job descriptions for every role.



  





***BUILDING THE HR FUNCTION:***



* Set up HR structures, processes, and systems from scratch.
* Build and lead a small HR team as the group's needs grow.
* Create an employee handbook and core policies covering leave, attendance, conduct, dress code, and grievances.
* Introduce an HR system and maintain complete, accurate employee records.



  





***ONBOARDING AND TRAINING:***



* Design a structured induction for new joiners across each business.
* Work with store leads to deliver training in product knowledge and luxury client service.
* Make sure every new hire's first 90 days are well supported.



  





***PAYROLL , COMPLIANCE , AND HR OPERATIONS:***



* Work with the accounts and payroll team to ensure salaries, incentives, and statutory deductions are accurate and on time.
* Own employment contracts, offer letters, and full\-and\-final settlements.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, including PF, ESI, gratuity, Shops and Establishments registrations, and the POSH Act, including setting up the Internal Committee.



  





***PERFORMANCE AND REWARDS:***



* Set up a regular performance review cycle with clear expectations for every role.
* Work with the founders to design fair salary bands and sales incentive structures.



  





***EMPLOYEE RELATIONS AND RETENTION:***



* Be the first point of contact for staff concerns, grievances, and disciplinary matters, handling each fairly and discreetly.
* Track attrition, run exit interviews, and act on what they reveal.
* Build a culture of engagement and recognition across stores, workshops, and teams.



  





***Who you are:***




  




* You have 6 to 10 years of HR experience, including time in retail, luxury, hospitality, or another business with large frontline teams.
* You have a strong track record of hiring at volume, for frontline staff, skilled craftspeople, and professionals alike.
* You're familiar with fashion roles such as fashion consultants and merchandisers, and you understand how luxury retail spaces run and what it takes to succeed in them.
* You have hands\-on knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* You have set up HR processes before, ideally as an early HR hire in a growing organization.
* You're organized, discreet, and fair, and you earn the trust of both staff and leadership.
* You communicate clearly in English and Hindi. Telugu is an advantage.
* A postgraduate qualification in HR is a plus.



  





***What the role offers:***




  




* The chance to build an HR function from scratch for an established luxury fashion group.
* Direct access to the founders and real influence over how the group grows.
* Exposure to seven distinct businesses across retail, craft, and online.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.



  





***How to apply:***




  




* **Apply via Linkedin or email:** 
 :
 **elahe@elahe.co.in**
* **In the note, describe an HR function or hiring process you've built, and what you would priorities in your first 90 days at One Elahe LLP.**

title: Senior Manager, Global Mobility Operations
description:
**About Amgen**
 If you feel like you are part of something bigger, it’s because you are. At Amgen, our shared mission—to serve patients—drives all that we do. It is key to our becoming one of the world’s leading biotechnology companies. We are global collaborators who achieve together—researching, manufacturing, and delivering ever\-better products that reach over 10 million patients worldwide. It’s time for a career you can be proud of. Join us.
   

  

**Role Summary**
 The Senior Manager, Global Mobility Operations leads the day\-to\-day operational delivery of Amgen's global mobility and immigration programs, ensuring employees are supported through compliant, efficient and consistent relocation and immigration services. This role translates enterprise mobility strategy into operational execution while leading service delivery, vendor engagement, process improvement, compliance and a high\-performing team.
   

  

 The role leads service delivery, vendor engagement, operational performance, process improvement, compliance and a high\-performing Global Mobility Operations team with full people\-management accountability.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor to HR, Talent Acquisition and business leaders, the Senior Manager helps deliver an exceptional employee experience that enables Amgen to attract and move talent in support of its mission to serve patients.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead day\-to\-day execution of global mobility programs supporting domestic and international employee movement.
* Translate enterprise mobility strategy, policy direction and business objectives into team priorities, operating plans, service standards, KPIs and measurable operational outcomes.
* Drive operational excellence through process improvements, automation and standardized ways of working.
* Ensure consistent execution of mobility policies, procedures and operational governance.
* Oversee operational delivery of relocation services supporting new hires, international assignments, transfers and localization activities.
* Lead the processes while partnering with internal Tax, external tax provider, team members and HR leaders, related to cross\-border, non\-traditional movement for remote work and role relocation requests
* Oversee operational processes for trailing equity and trailing bonus for our Mobile population, coordinating with tax vendor and providing guidance to internal payrolls, HR and staff members
* Partner with Tax vendor and provide oversight to global payrolls related to shadow payroll reporting for compensation, relocation and trailing income
* Resolve complex operational issues while balancing employee experience, compliance and business priorities.
* Own operational performance and outcomes across Global Mobility Operations, including service quality, compliance, timeliness, employee experience and continuous improvement.
* Partner with external providers to support timely and effective service delivery.
* Support complex immigration matters in partnership with the Immigration support members on the team to provide guidance, escalation management and issue resolution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Talent Acquisition and business leaders on mobility processes and relocation solutions.
* Partner closely with the Global Mobility COE Strategy Lead to implement enterprise mobility strategy and policy updates.
* Deliver reporting and operational insights that support program effectiveness and continuous improvement.
* Partner with the COE on day\-to\-day operational engagement with relocation providers, immigration counsel and other mobility partners.
* Monitor service delivery, operational performance and issue resolution while partnering with Global Mobility COE Lead on vendor governance.
* Manage assigned Global Mobility operational budgets and/or vendor spend, including forecasting, monitoring expenditures and allocating resources within approved parameters.
* Lead, coach and develop a high\-performing Global Mobility Operations team of 3 direct reports, with full accountability for people management, performance and development.
* Set priorities, allocate resources and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Build capability through coaching, feedback, development planning and knowledge sharing.
* Ensure compliance with applicable immigration, employment, payroll, tax and data privacy requirements.
* Maintain operational documentation, audit readiness and governance processes.
* Identify risks and recommend mitigation actions that strengthen service quality and compliance.


**Required Qualifications**
**What We Expect from You**
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, International Business, Law or a related field.
* 11\+ years of progressive experience in Global Mobility, Immigration, International Human Resources or a related discipline within a global organization.
* Experience leading operational teams and developing high\-performing talent.
* Strong knowledge of global mobility operations, relocation and immigration processes.
* Experience partnering with external service providers and managing operational delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across a matrixed organization.
* Strong analytical, communication and problem\-solving skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Advanced degree or professional certification such as GMS, CRP, SHRM or equivalent.
* Experience supporting scientific, technical or executive populations.
* Experience managing operational budgets and/or significant external vendor spend.
* Experience with mobility technology, reporting tools or process automation.

title: Associate-Resource Management
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Resource Management Advanced Associate**
 As a Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will be part of an industry leading, high performing and agile team of workforce management professionals providing exceptional client service to our stakeholders and helping our employees gain differential experiences that are aligned to their career aspirations.
   

  

 We provide learning and growth opportunities to build your ability to analyze, innovate, think and act globally. You’ll be part of an organization that is focused on optimization, is solution oriented, innovates and provides best in class services to the client serving teams.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY Global Delivery Services (EY GDS) is a dynamic and global service delivery network of over 50,000 professionals working across borders, to provide innovative and strategic business solutions to EY member firms and EY clients globally. Resource Management plays a vital role in the firm’s Next Wave strategy and it’s purpose of building a better working world.
   

  

 We offer a great place to work for every person joining EY. At GDS, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills in a truly global environment. You will learn and gain experiences from industry leading WFM professionals and a path breaking leadership team.
   

  

 We invest in your learning and development. We’ll help you develop the technical and soft skills you need. We support your professional development with a combination of learning, networking, experiences, and coaching. As part of a 300\+ member team, supporting 4 unique Service Lines, you will always have opportunities to showcase your skills and contribute to the firm’s strategic initiatives.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
 As an Resource Management Advanced Associate, you will work as the staffing point of contact for the assigned region/service/competency team and will be responsible to work with the service delivery managers in capturing staffing demand projections, analyze demand intake patterns, demand – supply matching, demand – supply gaps, schedule individuals on projects, optimize employee utilization and bench management.
   

  

**Some of your key responsibilities include:**
* Capture demand projections, understand demands heuristics and identify actionable demand.
* Calculate staffing requirements based on demand projections, delivery deadlines and productivity targets.
* Identify suitable staffing options based on matching skills, roles and experiences.
* Create staffing schedules to maximize service and minimize cost.
* Timely update of employee schedules on the schedule management tool (Retain).
* Timely review and resolution of scheduling conflicts.
* Proactive review of resource availability/future project demands.
* Minimize bench pipeline through proactive deployment on projects.
* Minimize open, unfulfilled demand.
* Track monitor and report on WFM KPIs such as employee utilization, time to fulfil demand, unfulfilled demand % and bench aging.
* Basic reporting and analysis.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
 Graduates with 2\-3 years of relevant workforce management experience. Understanding of business models, operational and financial aspects of service delivery will be preferred. The suitable candidate should have good analytical skills, can compute staffing demands, validate skills and experiences associated with the demand, identify suitable fulfilment options from the internal pool of professionals available for allocation or on bench and negotiate staffing solutions with the service delivery managers.
   

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Excellent analytical skills.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel.
* Excellent teaming and interpersonal skills.
* Positive attitude and ability to excel under tight timelines.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Experience on workforce management concepts, resource deployment and scheduling.
* Working knowledge and subject matter expertise in resource management, demand planning and scheduling in reputed consulting, technology, financial services, accounting and professional services organizations.


**What We Look For**
 We are looking for go\-getters with a solution oriented and analytical mindset. Someone who is good with numbers and has the willingness to learn. The successful candidate will be one who combines computer skills and mathematical ability with a working knowledge of the business and the negotiation skills of a salesman.
   

  

**What We Offer**
 EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well\-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever\-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
   

  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Assistant - PE Shared Services
description:

A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.
   

  

 As a
 **Senior Assistant – PE Shared Services** 
 you will play an important role in delivering accurate, timely, and high\-quality People Operations services across the employee lifecycle.
   

  

 You will manage complex HR transactions and employee data across systems such as
 **Workday and ServiceNow** 
 , while ensuring data integrity, compliance, and adherence to established service levels and operating procedures.
   

  

 In addition to day\-to\-day operations, you will take ownership of processes, support issue resolution and escalations, partner with global stakeholders, identify opportunities for process improvement and automation, and contribute to enhancing the overall employee experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Manage end\-to\-end employee lifecycle transactions in Workday and other HR systems, including new hires, onboarding, employee data changes, promotions, compensation changes, transfers, international movements, organizational changes, leave\-related transactions, and terminations.
* Process, validate, and audit HR transactions to ensure accuracy, completeness, compliance, and data integrity across HR systems.
* Manage employee and manager requests through ServiceNow, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with defined SLAs and quality standards.
* Manage and validate data movement and integrations between HR systems, including Workday, payroll systems, recruiting platforms, and other downstream applications.
* Support payroll\-related activities by ensuring employee changes and required data are processed accurately within established payroll cut\-off timelines.
* Manage and maintain employee documentation and digital employee records in accordance with applicable retention, security, and privacy requirements.
* Support employment verification and employment eligibility processes, including applicable documentation and system updates.
* Support global and country\-specific People Operations processes, including Leave of Absence, parental leave, onboarding, offboarding, and other workforce administration activities.
* Research and resolve complex employee data and transaction issues, partnering with Payroll, Talent Acquisition, HR/People Partners, Centers of Excellence, and other teams as required.
* Act as a point of support for complex operational queries and escalations, ensuring issues are investigated and resolved appropriately.
* Perform quality checks and support audits to identify process or data gaps and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information in accordance with EA information security, data privacy, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times, and enhance employee and stakeholder experience.
* Contribute to process improvement, automation, system enhancement, testing, and implementation initiatives within People Operations.
* Maintain and improve process documentation, SOPs, knowledge articles, and other operational resources.
* Provide feedback and recommendations on recurring issues, process gaps, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support testing and validation of HR system enhancements, new functionality, and process changes before implementation.
* Partner effectively with global and regional stakeholders and provide clear, timely updates on operational requests, issues, and priorities.
* Support knowledge sharing and provide guidance to team members on processes, systems, and operational best practices.
* Track operational performance and contribute to achieving agreed SLA, quality, accuracy, and customer experience targets.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* 5\+ years of relevant experience in HR Operations, People Operations, HR Shared Services, or workforce administration.
* Hands\-on experience working with an HRIS/HCM platform, preferably Workday.
* Experience with case management or ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow.
* Good understanding of employee lifecycle processes and HR data management.
* Experience working in a global or regional HR Shared Services/People Operations environment is preferred.
* Experience supporting multiple countries or geographic\-specific HR processes is an advantage.
* Experience working with payroll\-related employee data and payroll cut\-off activities is preferred.
* Exposure to HR process improvement, automation, system testing, or operational projects is an advantage.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strong attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy and quality.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex operational issues.
* Strong customer\-service mindset with a focus on delivering a positive employee experience.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple requests in a fast\-paced, high\-volume environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong ownership and accountability with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team.
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential employee information with discretion.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, Google Workspace, Workday, and ServiceNow.
* Continuous improvement mindset with an interest in leveraging automation, technology, and AI\-enabled solutions to improve HR operational efficiency.
* Ability to adapt to changing priorities, processes, systems, and business requirements.
* Ability to support and guide junior team members through knowledge sharing and operational best practices.


**About Electronic Arts**
 We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
   

  

 We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well\-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more.  HR professionals with 5 to 8 years of experience, including at least 2 years as the sole or lead HR person in a firm of 20 to 60 people (accounting or CA firm, KPO, BPO, IT services or similar). **About Cornerstone**

 You will own a product area end to end: the problems it solves, the roadmap that gets there, and the outcomes it produces. You'll work daily with engineering squads, a designer, and stakeholders across sales, customer success, and support. This is a builder's role — we expect you to form your own point of view on what to build, defend it with evidence, and be accountable for whether it worked

 Own a problem space, not a feature list
   

  

 Develop deep understanding of your area — the users, the jobs they're trying to get done, the workflows around your product, and where the current experience breaks down.
   

  

 Maintain a prioritized roadmap tied to explicit business and customer outcomes, and be able to explain the reasoning behind any item on it — including what you chose not to build.

 Ship with your squad
   

  

 Partner with engineering and design from problem framing through release — refinement, trade\-off calls, scope decisions, and unblocking during the sprint.
   

  

 Break large initiatives into releasable increments so customers see value early and often.
   

  

 Own launch readiness: enablement content, release notes, support handoff, and rollout plan.
   

  

 Work from evidence
   

  

 Talk to customers regularly — discovery calls, feedback sessions, and reviewing real usage in the product.
   

  

 Define the instrumentation and success metrics for what you ship, then go back and check whether the metrics moved.
   

  

 Manage stakeholders across regions
   

  

 Represent your area to sales, customer success, support, and leadership; translate customer escalations and field requests into product signal without letting the loudest voice set the roadmap.
   

  

 Work effectively across time zones with counterparts in the US and EMEA..
   

  

**You Have Got What It Take If You Have**
 2–4 years in product management, including at least 2 years owning a product area for a B2B or enterprise SaaS product.
   

  

 A track record of features you shipped and can speak to concretely: what problem it solved, what you decided and why, what the outcome was, and what you'd do differently.
   

  

 Strong written communication. You can write a PRD an engineer can build from and a one\-pager an executive can decide from.
   

  

 Comfort with data — you can pull and interpret product analytics, define events worth tracking, and reason about a funnel without waiting for someone else to build the dashboard.
   

  

 Experience working directly with engineering in an agile environment, including making scope trade\-offs under real deadlines.
   

  

 Bachelor's degree, or equivalent experience.
   

  

**Nice to have**
 Domain background in HR tech, learning management, talent development, recruiting, or workforce planning.
   

  

 Experience with AI/ML\-driven product features — recommendations, matching, search relevance, or agent\-based workflows — including how to evaluate quality and handle failure modes.
   

  

 Experience shipping localized products or working with globally distributed engineering teams.
   

  

 Exposure to enterprise sales cycles, RFPs, or public\-sector customers
   

  

**Our Culture**
 Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Cornerstone powers the potential of organizations and their people to thrive in a changing world. Cornerstone Galaxy, the complete AI\-powered workforce agility platform, meets organizations where they are. With Galaxy, organizations can identify skills gaps and development opportunities, retain and engage top talent, and provide multimodal learning experiences to meet the diverse needs of the modern workforce. More than 7,000 organizations and 100 million\+ users in 180\+ countries and in nearly 50 languages use Cornerstone Galaxy to build high\-performing, future\-ready organizations and people today.

* Experience supporting recruitment and managing hiring coordination.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, attention to detail, and data accuracy.

* Ability to manage confidential information and work independently with US stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Job Description**
 Your potential has a place here with TTEC's award\-winning employment experience. As a Principal Analyst working onsite in Hyderabad, India, you'll be a part of bringing humanity to business. \#experienceTTEC
   

  

 Our employees have spoken. Our purpose, team, and company culture are amazing and our Great Place to Work® certification in India says it all!
   

  

**Job Title**
**Principal Analyst – Taleo Application (IT Enterprise Solutions)**
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking an experienced Principal Analyst to own the strategy, configuration, integration, and support of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition (ATS) platform. The ideal candidate will bring strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment lifecycle, deep hands\-on expertise across all Taleo modules and features, and proven experience delivering full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementations. This role requires a seasoned professional who can independently manage integrations with HRMS/ERP systems, background check providers, job boards, and career sites, while serving as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and external vendors.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
***End\-to\-End Recruitment Process \& Taleo Application Ownership***
* Own and drive functional and technical ownership of the Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition platform across all modules, including Taleo Recruiting (OTAC), Onboarding, Career Sections (internal and external), and Taleo Connect Client (TCC).
* Demonstrate strong functional knowledge of the complete recruitment lifecycle – requisition creation and approval, sourcing, candidate screening, interview scheduling, offer management, background verification, and onboarding – and translate this knowledge into effective Taleo configurations.
* Lead the design, configuration, testing, and rollout of new Taleo features, workflows, and enhancements aligned to evolving recruitment and business needs.
* Provide advanced production support and root\-cause troubleshooting for issues related to requisitions, workflows, offers, career sites, and integrations.
* Manage Taleo upgrades, patches, and release cycles, ensuring minimal disruption to live recruitment operations.


***Taleo Connect Client (TCC) \& Integrations***
* Serve as the hands\-on subject matter expert for Taleo Connect Client (TCC), independently building, testing, scheduling, and troubleshooting inbound/outbound data integrations and exports/imports.
* Design, build, and maintain integrations between Taleo and HRMS/ERP systems, including Oracle ERP/HCM, ensuring seamless data flow for candidate, requisition, and employee records.
* Own integrations with background check providers, job boards/aggregators, and career site platforms, ensuring accurate posting, sourcing, and candidate data exchange.
* Work with XML, CSV, flat\-file structures, web services, and APIs to support integration development, monitoring, and error resolution.
* Ensure data integrity, security, and compliance across all integration touchpoints in line with organizational and regulatory requirements.


***Implementation \& Project Delivery***
* Independently manage and execute Taleo ATS implementations end\-to\-end, from requirements gathering and solution design through configuration, testing, cutover, and hypercare support.
* Prepare functional and technical specification documents, configuration workbooks, test scripts, and cutover/rollout plans.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) cycles, coordinate defect resolution, and manage go\-live readiness.
* Drive process improvement initiatives to optimize recruitment workflows, system performance, and user experience.


***Stakeholder \& Vendor Management***
* Act as the primary liaison between HR, Talent Acquisition, IT, and business leadership to gather requirements and translate them into scalable Taleo solutions.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across geographies, managing expectations, timelines, and priorities effectively.
* Manage relationships with Oracle Taleo support, implementation partners, background check vendors, and job board/career site providers, including contract deliverables, SLAs, and issue escalation.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with technical and non\-technical audiences, through written documentation, presentations, and verbal updates to stakeholders and leadership.


***Reporting, Compliance \& Mentoring***
* Develop and maintain standard and custom Taleo reports and dashboards to support recruiting metrics, compliance reporting, and executive insights.
* Ensure recruitment processes and system configurations align with applicable compliance requirements (e.g., EEOC, OFCCP, GDPR, and internal audit/SOX controls where applicable).
* Provide technical and functional guidance to junior analysts and HR systems team members, and contribute to knowledge transfer, training, and documentation.


**Required Qualifications**
***Experience***
* 8–12\+ years of overall IT/HR systems experience, with a significant portion focused on Oracle Taleo Enterprise Edition.
* Proven track record of having managed and executed at least one full\-cycle Taleo ATS implementation, in addition to multiple enhancement and support engagements.
* Mandatory hands\-on expertise with Taleo Connect Client (TCC), including building and troubleshooting integrations independently.
* Demonstrated experience integrating Taleo with HRMS/ERP platforms (e.g., Oracle ERP/HCM), background check providers, job boards, and career sites.


***Technical \& Functional Skills***
* Strong functional command of the end\-to\-end recruitment process and how it maps to Taleo Recruiting, requisition lifecycle, candidate management, and offer processes.
* In\-depth, hands\-on knowledge of Taleo application features and functions across Recruiting, Onboarding, and Career Sections.
* Proficiency with XML, CSV, and data integration techniques, along with web services and APIs.
* Experience with Career Section configuration, branding, and localization.
* Strong reporting and analytics capability within the Taleo platform.


***Soft Skills***
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, negotiate, and drive alignment across cross\-functional and cross\-geography teams.
* Demonstrated vendor management experience, including managing SLAs, escalations, and deliverables with external partners.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making abilities.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and lead initiatives in a fast\-paced environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Oracle Taleo certification(s).
* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud or Oracle ERP integrations.
* Exposure to global recruiting processes and compliance requirements (GDPR, EEOC, OFCCP).
* Prior experience in large enterprise or global HR/IT environments.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology , Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).


**What You Can Expect**
* Supportive of your career and professional development
* An inclusive culture and community\-minded organization where giving back is encouraged
* A global team of curious lifelong learners guided by our company values
* Ask us about our paid time off (PTO) and wellness and healthcare benefits
* And yes… a great compensation package and performance bonus opportunities, benefits you'd expect and maybe a few that would pleasantly surprise you


**About TTEC**
 Our business is about making customers happy. That's all we do. Since 1982, we've helped companies build engaged, pleased, profitable customer experiences powered by our combination of humanity and technology. On behalf of many of the world's leading iconic and hypergrowth brands, we talk, message, text, and video chat with millions of customers every day. These exceptional customer experiences start with you.
   

  

 TTEC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. TTEC embraces and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce that respects and empowers the cultures and perspectives within our global teams. We aim to reflect the communities we serve, by not only delivering amazing service and technology, but also humanity. As a global company, we know diversity is our strength because it enables us to view things from different vantage points and for you to bring value to the table in your own unique way.

title: HR Partner - Oakridge International School - Gachibowli
description:
Oakridge Gachibowli is a premium international day school in India. We have the proud privilege of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. We have 150\+ IB\-trained teachers with years of experience, helping us consistently achieve outstanding results and seeing our students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is a leading premium day school in India, with more than 2800 students in full time enrollment. The school has a proud legacy of 22 years educational excellence and of being the pioneers of IB schooling in South India and one of the largest providers of IB education in India. The school has 150\+ IB\-trained teachers, enabling consistent outstanding results and inspire students go on to study at some of the world’s leading universities. The school serves Nursery through to high school (Grade 12\) students. Oakridge offers IB, CBSE, and Cambridge curricula, and is recognized as one of the best schools in Hyderabad, India.
   

  

 The Oakridge International School, Gachibowli is partnered with the Nord Anglia Education family, the world’s leading premium international school organisation. They currently have 81 schools in India, China, Europe, the Middle East, South East Asia and North, Central and South America. NAE are a fast growing, successful education company with over 50 years’ experience. The schools are amongst the most respected premium schools in their markets and are a very popular choice for parents.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The HR Business Partner (HRBP) is a strategic role responsible for aligning HR practices with the school’s goals and educational mission. Acting as a trusted advisor to school leadership and faculty, the HRBP supports workforce planning, employee relations, talent management, performance development, and change management. The role ensures that HR initiatives promote a positive, inclusive, and high\-performing school culture.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic HR Partnership:** 
 Collaborate with school leadership to understand staffing needs and workforce planning.Align HR strategies with academic and operational goals.Provide data\-driven insights to support decision\-making and organizational effectiveness.
   

  

**Talent Acquisition \& Onboarding:** 
 Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and lead recruitment for teaching, administrative, and support staff.Ensure timely onboarding and orientation of new hires.Promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in hiring practices.
   

  

**Employee Relations \& Engagement:** 
 Foster a positive work environment through proactive engagement and support.Handle employee concerns, grievances, and conflict resolution in a fair and consistent manner.Develop and implement initiatives that support staff well\-being and retention.
   

  

**Performance Management \& Development:** 
 Support performance appraisal processes and goal\-setting practices.Collaborate with department heads to identify professional development needs.Guide leadership and staff on career development opportunities and succession planning.
   

  

**Compliance \& Policy Implementation:** 
 Ensure compliance with labor laws, school policies, and relevant educational regulations.Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date HR documentation and records.Lead internal audits and HR reporting as needed.
   

  

 Detailed JD : JD \- HR Partner \- OIS.pdf
   

  

 At Nord Anglia Education we are committed to providing a world class, safe, happy environment in which children and young people can thrive and learn. We are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all our pupils where we embrace all race, abilities, religions, genders, and cultures.
   

  

 All post holders in regulated activity (having regular unsupervised contact with children) are subject to appropriate national and international vetting procedures including satisfactory criminal record checks from both your country of residence/birth and any country of residence within the last 10 years.
   

  

 We welcome applications from suitable qualified persons from all diverse backgrounds.
   

  

 Please note, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: People Director
description:
**About the Team**
 The India People team is establishing the people practices and employee experience that will support the launch and growth of our Hyderabad site. We partner closely with site leaders and employees to create effective teams, consistent leadership practices, and a healthy, sustainable workplace as the operation scales.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As the India People Business Partner, you will be a highly visible, hands\-on presence at the Hyderabad site, staying close to daily operations, leaders, and employees throughout the site's launch, growth, and stabilization. You will support employee engagement, manager effectiveness, organizational effectiveness, talent management, employee relations, workforce planning, and change management. You will coordinate two Human Resources Generalists and use people data to identify risks, improve day\-to\-day execution, and help shape the site's future people practices. You will report to the People Director on our EE People Ops \- HR Business Partner HRBP team in our HR organization.
   

  

**Schedule:** 
 Night Shift —
 **5:00 PM–2:00 AM or 6:00 PM–3:00 AM**
**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
* Partner daily with site and functional leaders on team effectiveness, manager support, performance concerns, role clarity, workforce needs, and other people topics that emerge as the site scales.
* Support employee engagement, workplace culture, team health, and manager consistency while helping leaders and employees navigate new processes, changing structures, and operating model changes.
* Support team design, workforce planning, succession planning, talent cycles, and role clarity while identifying opportunities to improve the site's organizational effectiveness.
* Manage sensitive employee relations matters, support investigations and escalations, and promote consistent application of company policies and local labor requirements.
* Coordinate and prioritize the work of two Human Resources Generalists while partnering with the Senior Manager or Director on organizational decisions, talent priorities, escalations, and site\-level people risks.


**We're excited about you because…**
* You have 6\+ years of progressive experience in a People Business Partner, Human Resources Business Partner, or comparable role supporting business leaders and employees.
* You have experience providing hands\-on people support in a high\-growth, site\-based, operations\-focused, or multi\-shift environment.
* You have applied knowledge of employee relations, sensitive investigations, policy administration, and employment compliance in India.
* You have experience coaching managers and supporting organizational effectiveness, succession planning, talent processes, workforce planning, employee engagement, and organizational change.
* You are able to work fully onsite in Hyderabad during a night shift of either 5:00 p.m.–2:00 a.m. or 6:00 p.m.–3:00 a.m.


**About DoorDash**
 At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
   

  

 DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
   

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
 We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: People & Culture Lead
description:
**People \& Culture Lead** 




**Hyderabad, India · Reports to Strategy ·** 
**India operations with US entity coordination** 




  





 Own the People function as a true Global HRBP for a 500\+ person India operation supporting a US\-headquartered entity. This is a strategic business\-partnering role first, and an operational ownership role second: you'll sit close to Founders and Function Leads as their HR counterpart across two geographies, shaping org design, talent strategy and workforce decisions in real time — while also owning the full employee lifecycle end to end.
 **Prior experience operating as an HRBP across multiple countries (ideally India \+ US) is required** 
 — this is not a single\-market generalist role.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




**Global HR Business Partnering (core of the role)** 




 Act as the primary HR partner to Founders and Function Leads across both the India and US contexts — understanding each business unit's goals and translating them into people strategy, org design, and workforce decisions. Advise on organisational design, role architecture, reporting structure and the levelling framework across two regulatory regimes and two talent markets. Bring a comparative lens: know how HR practices, employment norms and talent expectations differ between India and the US, and design policies/programmes that work coherently across both without defaulting to a single\-market template. Be the escalation point Founders and leaders turn to for judgment calls on people issues, not just process execution.
 



  





**Function ownership** 




 Own the P\&C agenda, roadmap and operating model globally. Own the organisational knowledge architecture \- SOPs, handbooks, lifecycle documentation and the knowledge directory \- and keep the documented record current and continuity\-proof across both entities.
 



  





**Talent acquisition** 




 Own hiring across technical and non\-technical roles in India, partnering with US\-side stakeholders on cross\-border hiring needs: requisition governance, pipeline health, interview frameworks and hiring manager enablement. **Performance and development** 




 Own the performance and goal\-setting cycle and its alignment to company objectives and board reporting, across both geographies. Design and facilitate manager and leadership development. Run recognition programmes tied to company values.
 



  





**Compliance and employee relations** 




 Hold accountability for statutory compliance across the India entity, including the Labour Codes and POSH, while coordinating closely with legal counsel and US HR/legal on US\-side employment obligations. Manage grievances and investigations, and operate separation processes for voluntary and business\-reason exits across both entities.
 



  





**Data and reporting** 




 Maintain headcount tracking, org charts and workforce data as the single source of truth across India and US populations. Prepare people data for board, investor and diligence requirements, and the analysis behind global headcount planning.
 



  





**Corporate transactions** 




 Support mergers, acquisitions and structural changes: people\-side due diligence, workforce mapping, retention planning, harmonisation of terms across jurisdictions, and post\-transaction integration. Prior M\&A experience is preferred.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* **Required:** 
 Demonstrated HRBP experience, with direct exposure to managing HR across at least two countries — India and US experience specifically preferred.
* Strong grasp of comparative employment law/practice basics between India and the US (this role owns statutory compliance in India and coordinates US obligations, not the reverse).
* Comfort operating as a strategic partner to founders/leadership, not just a process owner.
* Prior M\&A / corporate transaction exposure preferred.

title: Workforce Management Lead
description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 The WFM Team Lead – Scheduling \& Intraday leads the end\-to\-end tactical execution layer of Workforce Management, integrating schedule optimisation, weekly workforce steering, real\-time operational control, and incident response under a single, cohesive leadership structure.
   

  

 This role ensures that approved capacity strategies are translated into structurally sound, compliant schedules (0–30 day horizon), proactively adjusted through weekly tactical steering, and actively protected through disciplined intraday performance management.
   

  

 Beyond operational oversight, the role operates as the Workforce Command Center lead — providing governance, decision control, and service protection during both stable and volatile operating conditions. It ensures workforce decisions are data\-informed, risk\-quantified, and aligned to service, productivity, and cost objectives.
   

  

 As part of the WFM Centre of Excellence (CoE), the role is accountable for embedding standardised workforce governance, decision frameworks, incident protocols, and execution discipline across Scheduling and Intraday functions. It drives the transition from reactive workforce administration to structured, analytics\-driven workforce control at scale.
   

  

 This position closes the loop between Forecast → Capacity → Schedule → Intraday → Continuous Improvement, ensuring execution learnings systematically improve tactical and structural planning quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Team Leadership \& Capability Development
* Lead and develop Scheduling and Intraday WFM Specialists.
* Define clear accountability boundaries across tactical and real\-time scopes.
* Elevate analytical maturity beyond administrative execution.
* Coach team members in Scenario modelling, Workforce risk quantification, Structured incident response
* Build succession strength and capability depth.
* Foster a culture of data\-driven decision\-making and ownership.
* Tactical Planning \& Schedule Governance (0–30 Day Horizon)
* Own end\-to\-end schedule publication governance.
* Ensure schedules reflect approved capacity plans, are interval\-accurate and structurally optimised, comply with labour and contractual obligations
* Oversee scenario testing and trade\-off validation prior to release.
* Balance service protection with cost efficiency and schedule stability.
* Approve short\-term workforce interventions (OT, VTO, temporary uplift).
* Identify systemic schedule weaknesses before operational impact.
* Weekly Workforce Steering
* Lead weekly tactical workforce performance reviews.
* Identify structural and emerging risks across 1–3 week horizon.
* Drive proactive adjustments to reduce intraday volatility.
* Align closely with Forecasting and Capacity Planning on emerging shifts.
* Ensure continuous feedback loop from execution into planning assumptions.
* Intraday Performance \& Operational Control
* Oversee real\-time service level, occupancy, and productivity monitoring.
* Ensure structured and rapid deviation diagnosis.
* Guide stabilisation interventions to prevent performance oscillation.
* Maintain disciplined escalation protocols with Operations leadership.
* Safeguard service performance during peak volatility.
* Incident Management \& Command Center Leadership
* Act as the Workforce Command Center lead during operational disruption.
* Own structured workforce response to demand surges, high absenteeism events, system/tool outages, service\-level degradation
* Quantify operational risk exposure and recovery timelines.
* Coordinate cross\-functional workforce interventions.
* Ensure incidents are managed through defined protocols, not reactive decisions.
* Lead post\-incident reviews and embed systemic improvements.
* WFM CoE Governance \& Standardisation
* Enforce WFM execution standards across Scheduling and Intraday.
* Drive adoption of workforce governance frameworks, incident playbooks, tactical review cadences, decision documentation standards
* Reduce dependency on ad hoc, spreadsheet\-driven processes.
* Strengthen system\-based optimisation and automation.
* Ensure auditability, reproducibility, and structural integrity of workforce decisions.
* Contribute to maturity uplift of the WFM operating model.
* Continuous Improvement \& Execution Excellence
* Identify recurring volatility drivers.
* Improve shrinkage modelling and break optimisation logic.
* Increase automation and reporting maturity.
* Reduce emergency interventions and reactive staffing.
* Improve alignment between planning accuracy and operational execution.


**Qualifications**
 You are passionate about leading people, building teams, and making a difference in your work, while also having a strong understanding of operational teams and processes. You have experience working across global teams, across different functions and you understand how to communicate cross\-culturally. You get it done. You can identify and resolve issues independently, taking initiative even under unfamiliar or ambiguous circumstances. You’ve worked with BI tools before like Looker etc. and your Excel/Spreadsheets skills are advanced! SQL and Python skills are a plus.
   

  

* Experience as a people lead: At least 3 years of experience leading teams and 2 years in a Workforce Management role.
* Independent problem solver: Ability to identify and resolve issues independently, even in unfamiliar or ambiguous situations.
* Self\-starter: Proven track record of taking ownership and creatively solving problems, while improving efficiency.
* Strong understanding of WFM: Knowledgeable in forecasting and different forecasting models, capacity planning, scheduling, and real\-time management.
* Strong relationships with stakeholders: Ability to connect and maintain relationships with various internal teams.
* Strategic and data\-driven: Ability to think strategically, translate strategy into operational plans, and analyse and interpret data.
* Process Expert: Lean Six Sigma experience to green\-belt level, understanding how to formally document processes, automate, improve efficiency, and reduce waste and cycle times across WFM practices


 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

title: Assistant Manager - HR Operations-Reward
description:
We are Reckitt

Now is an exciting time to be part of shaping the future of HR, influencing an exciting global organisation, while developing business and functional leadership skills, all at the same time.  This role is responsible not only for delivering Reward operations with high quality and discipline, but also for acting as a focal point for HR and business stakeholders, translating Reward principles into practical execution, identifying risks, and driving continuous improvement across processes, controls, and user experience.
   

  

 The role combines operational leadership (\~60–65%) with Reward expertise, advisory capability, and improvement leadership (\~35–40%).
   

  

 Your responsibilities

 The skills for success
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion, Data and Analytics, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Organisational structure, Coaching skills; Facilitation skills, Change management, Execute plans, Strategic mindset, Employment engagement, Digital literacy, Commercial accumen, Courageous leadership.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

description:
**Job Title: VP\- Business Manager**
 HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected, and opinions count. We foster continuous professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. As part of the Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function, you’ll play a vital role in supporting HSBC’s second line of defence, ensuring robust risk management and operational excellence across the Group.
   

  

 The Risk \& Compliance (R\&C) function is HSBC’s Second Line of Defence, responsible for reviewing and challenging the activities of the Group’s businesses to ensure effective risk management. With a global headcount of \~14,000 and annual costs of \~$1\.5bn, R\&C is evolving its operating model, requiring robust oversight, administration, and management. This role is pivotal in supporting the R\&C CAO CoE, driving operational excellence, and enabling strategic objectives in a dynamic, highly scrutinized environment. The role holder needs to understand the impact of all these changes on Risk \& Compliance and HSBC and support the Global R\&C COO, Global R\&C CAO and Head CAO CoE as necessary. The role holder will be required to interact with many internal and external parties at the highest level of management and therefore needs an outstanding level of professionalism and gravitas. As a Senior Business Manager within the R\&C C oE, you will be a strategic partner to Lines of Business and Global R\&C Sub\-functions, helping leaders turn centrally produced financial, workforce and performance data into clear decisions and practical action. You will connect insight with business context, identify risks and opportunities, generate ideas to improve performance and help shape priorities across the function. Reporting to the R\&C Head of CAO CoE India, you will work with global, regional and business stakeholders to translate information into a compelling performance story, challenge assumptions and coordinate delivery. Financial analysis and tracking remain important; however, the core data and reporting are produced centrally. Your value will come from interpreting what the data means, asking the right questions and enabling timely, well\-informed choices.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong business judgement, curiosity and influencing skills with an understanding of risk management and organisational performance. They will be comfortable leading a team, navigating a global matrix and moving stakeholders from insight to action.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
 The role holder will share good practice globally, lead a team and build trusted relationships across the function. Key responsibilities include:
   

  

* Partner with the Global R\&C CAO wider team and senior leaders to understand priorities, performance and delivery challenges across assigned Lines of Business and Global Sub\-functions. Use centrally produced financial, workforce and performance information to build a clear view of what is changing, why it matters and where leadership action is required.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities and emerging themes, connecting information across teams to generate ideas for improved performance, effectiveness and service delivery. Challenge assumptions and test whether plans, resources and investments remain aligned to business priorities.
* Use scenario analysis to explore choices, trade\-offs and potential outcomes for the relevant Sub\-function or Line of Business.
* Support decisions on consultancy, third\-party spend, hiring and out\-of\-plan requirements by assessing business need, value and alignment to priorities. Track agreed actions and outcomes, helping leaders understand whether interventions are delivering the intended impact.
* Support senior leaders across Lines of Business and Sub\-functions with integrated business management covering performance, people, priorities, governance and organisational effectiveness. Create clear leadership narratives from centrally produced Management Information, focusing discussion on decisions, actions and opportunities rather than reporting alone.
* Coordinate business planning and governance rhythms, ensuring priorities, dependencies and actions remain visible and connected. Coordinate and execute the business change and organisational design activity required to deliver the agreed financial resource plan, across both cost and FTE
* Build trusted relationships with R\&C leadership and partners across the Global Businesses, Global Functions, Finance and HR. Facilitate constructive, evidence\-based conversations that help stakeholders align on priorities and make timely decisions.
* Bring together perspectives from global and regional stakeholders to spot themes, share learning and scale effective ideas. Provide constructive challenge to existing practices and proposed initiatives, developing practical solutions to complex issues.
* Identify opportunities to improve value, simplify activity and redirect resources to the areas of greatest strategic importance.
* Lead, coach and develop direct reports, creating clear priorities and promoting curiosity, collaboration and high\-quality delivery. Support effective performance, talent and succession management across the team


**To Be Successful You Will**
**Knowledge \& Qualifications**
* Strong understanding of business management, organisational performance and strategy execution.
* Ability to interpret financial, workforce and operational information and connect it to business context and decisions. Sound understanding of the external banking environment, including regulatory, political and competitive factors.
* Strong awareness of internal control, operational risk and the role of Risk \& Compliance.
* Awareness of data governance and the importance of reliable, consistent information for decision\-making. Demonstrated success in using business, financial, workforce or operational insight to influence senior decisions and improve outcomes. Experience turning complex data and competing viewpoints into clear narratives, options and recommendations.
* Proven ability to identify opportunities, generate practical ideas and lead performance or organisational improvement.
* Experience working with central Finance, HR or data teams and applying their outputs within a business context.
* Strong stakeholder management experience in a complex, global matrix organisation. Experience shaping and delivering people, capability or engagement plans across diverse teams.
* Experience coordinating and executing business change and organisational design activity to deliver cost and FTE plans. Strategic and commercial judgement, with the ability to connect insight to business priorities. Intellectual curiosity and confidence asking questions that uncover the story behind the data.
* Ability to spot patterns, risks and opportunities and develop practical ideas in response.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and influencing skills, including with senior stakeholders. Strong leadership, collaboration and facilitation skills.
* Comfort interpreting data and scenarios without needing to own the underlying financial production processes.
* Proactive, resilient and effective in a fast\-moving international environment. Outstanding organisational and problem management skills, and extensive project and programme management exposure

title: Onboarding Experience Partner
description:
**Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd.** 
 is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
 **Good Health Can’t Wait.**




 We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
   

  





 For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Onboarding Experience Partner \- End\-to\-End Onboarding \& Day 1 Experience
   

  





  

  





 We are looking for a proactive, empathetic, and detail\-oriented professional to serve as the single point of contact for candidates throughout their onboarding journey, from Interview Selection to successful Day 1 Onboarding and Reporting.
   

  





 The role is responsible for managing the complete candidate onboarding lifecycle, including candidate engagement, offer acceptance support, onboarding coordination, Background Verification , Pre\-Medical management, Joining \& Relocation, Day 1 induction readiness, compliance governance, and employee experience management to ensure a seamless, compliant, and engaging onboarding experience.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 End\-to\-End Onboarding Ownership
   

  




* Own the complete onboarding lifecycle from interview selection to Day 1 reporting.
* Serve as the dedicated SPOC for candidates throughout their onboarding journey.
* Proactively engage with candidates to drive readiness, confidence, and joining commitment.
* Ensure timely completion of all onboarding milestones and compliance requirements.



 Candidate Experience \& Engagement
   

  




* Build meaningful relationships with candidates and provide personalized support.
* Drive a best\-in\-class onboarding experience that strengthens employer brand perception.
* Identify and mitigate risks that could impact candidate joining.
* Support offer acceptance, relocation, joining formalities, and pre\-joining queries.



 Operational Excellence \& Governance
   

  




* Manage Background Verification , Pre\-Medical, documentation, and onboarding compliance processes.
* Track onboarding readiness and maintain governance dashboards and trackers.
* Monitor onboarding SLAs and ensure timely closure of activities.
* Collaborate with vendors and internal teams to resolve bottlenecks and escalations.



 Day 1 Experience Management
   

  




* Ensure complete Day 1 readiness, including system access, assets, workspace, and induction arrangements.
* Facilitate virtual and in\-person Day 1 induction programs.
* Troubleshoot onboarding issues and drive timely resolution.
* Deliver a smooth and memorable first\-day employee experience.



 Stakeholder Management
   

  




* Collaborate with Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partners, Hiring Managers, IT, Facilities, Security, Payroll, Finance, Admin, Vendors, and Business Leaders.
* Provide onboarding insights, updates, and risk assessments to stakeholders.
* Influence decisions and drive accountability across cross\-functional teams.



 Continuous Improvement
   

  




* Identify process gaps and recommend automation and experience enhancement opportunities.
* Analyze onboarding metrics and trends to improve candidate conversion and onboarding effectiveness.
* Contribute to transformation and employee experience initiatives.



 What We're Looking For
   

  





 Essential Skills
   

  




* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

title: Contingent Workforce Analyst II
description:
**Role Overview**
 The Contingent Workforce Approvals Analyst administers the approval workflow for temporary staff requests. The role monitors the intake form daily, checks each submission for completeness and accuracy, chases the requester for whatever is missing, puts the record into the format the approvers need, routes it to the right director and vendor manager, and tracks it through to final sign\-off and notification.
   

  

 This is a pivotal governance role, balancing administrative diligence with rigorous policy enforcement. Each verification step is essential: validating hiring manager hierarchies ensures proper authorization, location codes dictate cost and compliance protocols, budget confirmations prevent unapproved spending, and length\-of\-service tracking maintains policy adherence. Serving as the primary control point, you will mitigate risk by ensuring all requests are accurate and complete before processing, proactively preventing potential downstream compliance or operational exposure.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Request Intake \& Completeness Review
* Monitor submissions from the internal approval form daily, so no request waits on the analyst to notice it.
* Review each submission for completeness and accuracy, including hiring manager hierarchy, location codes and budget confirmation.
* Verify the requester has the standing to raise the request and that the approving hierarchy is correctly identified.
* Hold back incomplete or non\-compliant requests rather than routing them onward, and record why.
* Log every request so volume, ageing and approval cycle time can be reported.
* Clarification \& Data Finalisation
* Follow up with requesters using the established templates to resolve missing information, incorrect data formats and insufficient justification.
* Update request records into the required format, ensuring the scope of work detail and the objectives the role supports are captured.
* For extensions, include the previous request identifiers and length\-of\-service detail, since these determine whether the extension is permissible.
* Confirm budget and cost\-centre detail is present and consistent before the request moves to approval.
* Keep the requester informed, since these requests usually have a start date depending on them.
* Approval Routing \& Tracking
* Assign the appropriate director and vendor manager to each request based on the confirmed hierarchy.
* Loop in the assigned vendor manager for review and track the request through to final sign\-off.
* Chase approvals that stall, and escalate where a delay puts a start date or a compliance position at risk.
* Maintain accurate approval status throughout, so anyone can see where a request stands without asking.
* Handle rejections and rework cleanly, returning the request with a clear reason.
* Notification, Documentation \& Reporting
* Send approval notifications to hiring managers and requesters once a decision is reached.
* Record the final decision date and maintain the complete record of the approval chain.
* Provide the documentation required for extensions to the requester.
* Report on request volumes, approval cycle times, rejection reasons and ageing.
* Maintain the templates, procedures and knowledge base for the workflow, and propose improvements where the same clarification is needed repeatedly.


 PERFORMANCE \& SERVICE LEVELS
   

  

 Indicative performance targets for the role; final service levels are confirmed on engagement and measured per service line.
   

  

* Daily Monitoring: intake reviewed every business day, with no submission left unactioned overnight.
* Completeness Check: 100% of requests validated against the mandatory field set before routing; zero incomplete requests routed to approvers.
* Clarification Turnaround: requester follow\-up issued within the agreed window of identifying a gap.
* Approval Tracking: 100% of in\-flight requests carrying an accurate current status, with stalled approvals chased.
* Notification: decisions communicated and decision dates recorded for 100% of closed requests.
* Policy Compliance: extensions processed only with previous request identifiers and length\-of\-service detail present.
* First Meaningful Response: provide a meaningful technical update on 90% of requests within 2 business hours.
* Ticket Quality: sustain ≥95% against the weighted quality scorecard, which is weighted toward technical accuracy, then completeness, timeliness and communication.
* Customer Satisfaction: sustain ≥95% of responses rated Excellent or Good.


 TOOLS \& SYSTEMS
   

  

* Intake and workflow: the internal approval form and request tracker for submissions and status.
* Communication: shared mailbox, email templates and enterprise chat for requester and approver follow\-up.
* Records and reporting: spreadsheet trackers and BI tooling for cycle time, ageing and rejection analysis.
* Directory and organisational data: hierarchy and cost\-centre reference data used to identify the correct approvers.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory
   

  

* 2–5\+ years in workflow administration, contingent workforce or vendor management support, HR operations, or a comparable approvals and compliance coordination role.
* Demonstrated discipline validating submissions against a mandatory field set and holding back non\-compliant requests.
* Comfort navigating organisational hierarchies and identifying the correct approving authority.
* Accurate handling of cost\-centre, budget and location reference data.
* Excellent written English, since the role runs largely on templated follow\-up with senior stakeholders.
* Confidentiality judgement, as requests contain personal and commercial information.
* Willing and able to work a shift\-based roster, including night shifts, from the Hyderabad delivery centre.


**Preferred**
* Contingent workforce or vendor management systems experience.
* Exposure to length\-of\-service, tenure or co\-employment policy controls.
* Workflow or approvals automation experience.
* Reporting and dashboard building on cycle time and approval throughput.
* Procurement or HR operations certification, or working towards one.
